RINA is currently recruiting for a Senior Asset Integrity RBI Engineer to join its office in Rio de Janeiro within theOperations and Maintenance Engineering Division.

Mission

The Senior Asset Integrity RBI Engineer plays a pivotal role in optimizing inspection strategies within the Oil & Gas facilities or power plant by implementing risk-based inspection methodologies. Their mission is to assess the integrity of equipment and facilities, prioritize inspection activities based on risk assessment, and develop cost-effective inspection plans to ensure asset reliability, safety, and regulatory compliance. #LI-KM

Key Accountabilities

Risk Assessment and Analysis:

  • Conduct risk assessments of equipment and infrastructure using RBI methodologies.
  • Identify and evaluate potential failure modes, consequences, and likelihood of failure.
  • Analyze risk data to prioritize inspection activities according to risk levels.

Inspection Planning and Optimization:

  • Develop risk-based inspection plans tailored to specific equipment and process units.
  • Determine appropriate inspection techniques, frequencies, and inspection intervals based on risk assessment results.
  • Optimize inspection schedules to minimize downtime and maximize asset integrity.

Data Management and Documentation:

  • Maintain comprehensive records of inspection data, risk assessments, and inspection plans.
  • Utilize software tools and databases to manage RBI data and documentation effectively.
  • Ensure accuracy, completeness, and integrity of RBI data for informed decision-making.

Continuous Improvement and Compliance:

  • Identify opportunities for optimization and improvement of RBI processes and methodologies.
  • Stay abreast of industry developments, best practices, and regulatory requirements related to RBI and asset integrity management.
  • Ensure compliance with relevant safety standards, codes, and regulations governing inspection activities.

Communication and Collaboration:

  • Communicate RBI findings, recommendations, and inspection plans to stakeholders, including engineering teams, inspection and asset integrity personnel, and management.
  • Foster a culture of safety, reliability, and continuous improvement within the organization.
Education

Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering General or Chemical Engineering

Qualifications

  • Ceritification in API 571 and API 580 is considered an added value.
  • Fluent in Portuguese and English. Spanish is desirable.

description:
place Oslo, Norway

Data Scientist

One year in Norway, a career in Brazil—grow with us across borders

calendar_today

About Solution Seeker

Solution Seeker - with headquarters in Norway and a subsidiary in Brazil - is a scaleup building software and AI for industrial production optimization, turning data into value and strategic insight for our users.

Our software streams live sensor data from production facilities worldwide, processed in an event-driven, distributed system using patented algorithms to identify stable periods and select the most valuable data points for our machine learning models.

On top of this, we develop applications that help customers visualize and contextualize their data with our predictions and analyses, enabling them to make better production decisions. Beyond client work, we dedicate significant time and resources to cutting-edge machine learning research, including generative and probabilistic modeling, hybrid modeling (combining physics and ML), data-driven production optimization, and closed-loop identification.

As a Data Scientist, you will work hands-on with our data and play a key role in addressing some of the most important technical and strategic challenges we face. Your tasks may include:

  • Analyzing large volumes of production data to solve real customer challenges
  • Developing and optimizing our machine learning models
  • Designing and building applications based on customer needs
  • Preparing and delivering insightful presentations internally and externally
  • Contributing to strategic initiatives such as go-to-market plans, positioning, and delivery models

You’ll develop both technical and business expertise in a growing scaleup, giving you a strong foundation for future growth, whether you aim to specialize technically, move into business roles, or step into leadership.

About you

In addition to being technically skilled, you are naturally curious and never back down from a challenge. You are generous and accountable, always seeking to include others rather than exclude them. Your playful nature and willingness to contribute to the work environment make you a valuable team member because you know that happy developers mean happy customers.

You thrive in a young, international, fast-paced environment where your passion for continuous learning and innovation drives your success. Join us and be part of a team that embraces curiosity, warmth, playfulness, and punchiness as we create groundbreaking solutions and strengthen our position as world-leading experts in our field

Requirements
  • Fluency in English and Portuguese , both written and spoken (English will be your main working language)
  • Willingness to live 12 months in Oslo, Norway (from Feb 2026) and return to Rio to join the Brazilian team once your initial rotation is over.
  • Interest in digitalization, machine learning, and AI
  • Basic understanding of programming and strong logical reasoning skills
  • Ability to take initiative and deliver results
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills
  • Being Brazilian or possessing a valid work permit to work in Brazil (once your rotation in Oslo is over)
  • Bachelor’s degree in engineering or a related field
  • Our tech stack is large and we do not expect you to know all of it, but any familiarity would be greatly appreciated skills
  • Familiarity with Python
  • Experience working with large datasets
  • Experience/knowledge of Plotly Dash
  • Experience studying or working abroad
  • Experience with simulation, optimization, and modeling
  • Master’s degree in engineering or a related field
What we offer

To give you the best possible start before joining our Rio de Janeiro team, you’ll spend your first year with us at our headquarters in Oslo, where you’ll get a full onboarding into the company, our people, and our way of working. We will provide assistance related to obtaining the necessary visas/work permits before you can relocate to Oslo, and we will offer a competitive remuneration package for your stay in Norway, so you can focus on learning, contributing to the company, and enjoying the experience.

At Solution Seeker, we believe work should be both meaningful and fun. You’ll have the freedom to shape your own workday, with opportunities to explore different teams and projects based on your interests.

Our culture is young, social, and collaborative—we enjoy lunch runs, after-work beers, company trips. Once back in Rio, you’ll carry that spirit with you, working closely with our Oslo team while enjoying the energy of our Brazilian office (and yes, the beaches are right there when you need them).

Senior Product Manager (Bangkok-based) – Agoda

Join to apply for the Senior Product Manager (Bangkok-based) role at Agoda .

About Agoda

Agoda is an online travel booking platform for accommodations, flights, and more. We build and deploy cutting-edge technology that connects travelers with a global network of 4.7M hotels and holiday properties worldwide, plus flights, activities, and more. Based in Asia and part of Booking Holdings, our 7,100+ employees representing 95+ nationalities in 27 markets foster a work environment rich in diversity, creativity, and collaboration. We innovate through a culture of experimentation and ownership, enhancing the ability for our customers to experience the world.

Our Purpose - Bridging the World Through Travel

We believe travel allows people to enjoy, learn and experience more of the amazing world we live in. It brings individuals and cultures closer together, fostering empathy, understanding and happiness. We are a skillful, driven and diverse team from across the globe, united by a passion to make an impact. Harnessing our innovative technologies and strong partnerships, we aim to make travel easy and rewarding for everyone.

Your opportunity

This role is BANGKOK-BASED, RELOCATION PROVIDED. Our Senior Product Managers are analytical and data-driven individuals, responsible for building products end-to-end, focusing on analyzing and experimenting until our solutions are perfectly tailored to our travelers. You will drive product strategy and partner closely with senior leadership cross-functionally to define, build, and deliver the best travel solutions. You will get dedicated engineering resources that you, and only you, define and allocate. We expect you to have a hands-on mentality and spend considerable time with your SCRUM teams, have enthusiasm to develop engineered processes and technologies and apply innovative solutions to make organizational improvements. Product Managers can modify every system we have in our company to suit their needs.

By applying to this role, you'll be considered for a role either in User Experience, Marketing, Finance or Supply product vertical. The goal is to match you with the team that best aligns with your interests, competencies, and where you will have the most impact. We’re looking for Senior Product Managers for every part of our business. Our entire Product team sits in Bangkok. This is an Individual Contributor position.

You will get to:

  • Conceptualize, launch and optimize products and features, experiment, test their performance and iterate quickly

  • Entrepreneurial and analytical skills; effective at breaking down complex problems and driving and managing change
  • Hands-on mentality

Nice to have:

  • MBA or Master’s degree in Math, Economics, Computer Science or Statistics
  • Data tools - SQL, Python, R, or equivalent

title: Senior maintenance engineer rotating equipment
description:
Overview

As a Senior Maintenance Engineer, you will collaborate closely with the clients Maintenance Engineering, Planning, and Offshore Operations teams, as well as Shapes remote specialists, to implement and optimize data-driven maintenance strategies for critical rotating equipment in the Oil & Gas sector. Your role will focus on condition monitoring, technical data analysis, and providing actionable recommendations to enhance equipment reliability, availability, and operational performance.

We are looking for a technically skilled professional with strong experience in predictive maintenance and rotating machinery diagnostics, capable of working across multidisciplinary teams to support continuous improvement.

Responsibilities
  • Analyze inspection and test data, focusing on vibration analysis (including spectra) and lubricant analysis to detect early signs of equipment failure.
  • Diagnose equipment condition and recommend corrective and predictive maintenance actions.
  • Create work notifications and service orders (WO/Notification) in CMMS to ensure accurate execution of maintenance activities.
  • Evaluate intervention effectiveness by analyzing results and calculating avoided costs.
  • Develop technical reports and performance indicators related to equipment and maintenance strategy.
  • Maintain and update technical case studies in Shape Lighthouse, ensuring traceability and knowledge retention.
  • Collaborate integrally with offshore teams, client engineering and planning, and Shapes remote specialists.
  • Support continuous development and enhancement of predictive maintenance strategies.
  • Ensure operational integrity, safety, and compliance with industry standards.
Requirements
  • Bachelors degree in Mechanical, Mechatronics, or related fields.
  • Proven experience in predictive maintenance, reliability, and diagnostics of rotating equipment (compressors, pumps, turbomachinery, etc.).
  • Advanced skills in vibration analysis, spectra interpretation, and condition monitoring data.
  • Knowledge of lubricant analysis and interpretation of physicochemical and particulate parameters.
  • Familiarity with maintenance management systems such as SAP PM, Maximo, or equivalents.
  • Experience with asset monitoring systems like OSIsoft PI, SCADA, or similar.
  • Understanding of predictive, prescriptive, and condition-based maintenance strategies.
  • Desirable certifications in vibration analysis (ISO CAT II or higher) and lubricant analysis.
Differentials
  • Previous experience in offshore environments (FPSOs, platforms, refineries, etc.).
  • Knowledge of industry standards such as API, ISO, NR-13.
  • Experience with failure analysis methodologies (FMEA, RCA, RCM).
  • Intermediate to advanced technical English.

The Talent Acquisition department hires qualified candidates to fill positions which contribute to the overall strategic success of Howard University. Hiring staff “for fit” makes significant contributions to Howard University’s overall mission.

At Howard University, we prioritize well-being and professional growth.

The National Associate & Regional Director (NARD) will support the daily operations of Howard University and the PNC National Center for Entrepreneurship (“the Center”). The NARD will play a critical leadership role in advancing the mission of the Center by supporting program strategy, partnership development, and national coordination of entrepreneurship initiatives. The NARD will collaborate with campus partners, funders, faculty, and student leaders to promote business innovation, entrepreneurship education, and venture creation.

This individual, who will report directly to the National Executive Director (NED), will serve as a critical broker between program funders, colleagues, students, the University, and the broader community. In this position, the NARD will assist the NED in managing the strategic and operations of the National Center including, working closely with Regional Directors in the center network, developing curriculum and programmatic activities, creating lecture opportunities for executives, managing and establishing relationships across the University and within varying sectors, creating program timelines, marketing of program outcomes, and any other related duties to help the success of the Center.

In addition, the NARD will assist the NED in tracking quantifiable data and statistical evidence to qualify the success of the Center. This will include tracking student and entrepreneur success and recommend ways in which improvements could be to assure the success of the Center. The NARD will also assist the NED in formally planning, assigning, directing, and coordinating the work of the Center employees.

Supervisory Accountability

The NARD will assist the NED to formally plan, assign, direct, and coordinate the work of the Center across the country. They will also assist in the management and supervision of National Center staff of professionals and support staff.

Nature And Scope

The NARD will be a university leader who will continue to drive the institution-wide culture of innovation and best practices. This leader will foster a vibrant work environment and be a trusted advisor and partner to the senior leadership team and the University community.

Principal Accountabilities

Strategic Program Development & Implementation

  • Lead the design, planning, implementation, and evaluation of national entrepreneurship programs and capacity-building initiatives with high impact on program participants

Partnerships & Stakeholder Engagement

  • Support the NED in cultivating and managing strategic partnerships with corporate, nonprofit, government, and philanthropic organizations
  • Serve as a liaison between the national center and entrepreneurship leaders at participating institutions and partnering organizations
  • Work collaboratively with faculty and staff at regional centers
  • Represent the center at national conferences, summits, and convenings

Operational Leadership

  • Oversee project timelines, budgets, and deliverables in collaboration with national and campus-based teams
  • Assist in the management and supervision of National Center staff of professionals and support staff
  • Serve as back-up in the absence of NED or other supervisory personnel
  • Perform other related duties as assigned

Core Competencies

  • Relevant leadership experience in a complex, dynamic environment
  • Experience with academic institutions and/or entrepreneurship preferred
  • Ability to manage a network of strategic partners and experience working with C-suite executives to build relationships
  • Skilled in planning work, ability to analyze, retain knowledge, show initiative and be resourceful in finding information pertaining to the job
  • Strong project management skills and experience leading multi-stakeholder initiatives
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills; grant writing experience preferred
  • Passion for entrepreneurship and community-driven innovation

Minimum Requirements

Master’s degree preferred and significant relevant experience at a managerial level is required.

title: Senior Research Analyst
description:
Role Purpose

Establishing resilient, sustainable and reliable portfolios is critical to energy companies as they develop agile business models to navigate the Energy Transition. We strive to be the partner of choice in offering a range of world-class products and services to support the business needs of these companies. Our global Subsurface Research Team delivers integrated research, data analysis and industry-leading thought leadership, across the geo-energy landscape, enabling customers to make quicker, more effective decisions. The scope, integrity and connectivity of our Subsurface dataset are foundational to our goal of delivering the market’s leading Subsurface solution. Additionally, the integration of high quality technical and commercial data is critical to enabling our customers to execute high value workflows and deliver data-driven insights to inform investment decisions for the Energy Transition. Reporting into our Subsurface Research Leadership, an experienced, highly motivated, innovative and performance oriented Senior Analyst is required to ensure analytics readiness, across our Subsurface dataset, for the Americas region.

Main Responsibilities
  • Work with the Upstream data function, Subsurface research analysts and the regional Upstream research teams, to ensure delivery of the Subsurface data expansion plan, including meeting agreed data coverage, completeness, integrity and timing OKRs – warranting that all options to deliver the plan have been explored / utilised
  • Work with Subsurface research analysts, and the Upstream product function, to ensure seamless connectivity (e.g. across basins, plays, prospects, wells and field reservoirs) of our Subsurface dataset
  • Ensure the that our Subsurface dataset is analytics ready for customers. Collaborate with our Upstream regional research teams to affect a cultural shift in Subsurface data accountability
  • Support the delivery of our Subsurface Value Creation Plan roadmap through deep participation in, and collaboration across, the associated workstreams
  • Build and develop a strong relationship network with our customers. Engage to understand their use cases, workflows, pain points and data needs in support of the continuous improvement of our offer
  • Help to build organisational capability within the data function through teaching, coaching and advising less experienced staff in support of Subsurface data excellence
  • Support the Subsurface team’s vision and agenda and be a positive advocate for Wood Mackenzie’s brand
  • Embrace, practise and demonstrate Wood Mackenzie’s core values on teamwork and collaboration, respect, integrity, fairness and valuing diversity
About You

You are passionate about the energy sector and the role it plays in delivering energy to the world. You have a curious and analytical mindset, understand the power of Subsurface data, and excited by the potential of AI across the Upstream value chain.

You are passionate about performance excellence and able to analyse and form clear, coherent conclusions from a variety of data and information. You find it easy communicating complex or technical information and delivering messages that are easily understood.

You thrive in a collaborative, commercial and client-centric environment and proven track record of fostering strong working relationships through coaching, influencing and developing others around you. The people around you recognise your ability to develop others and build an environment in which people thrive and deliver high quality results.

The way in which you work is productive and driven, striving to be best in class. You share ideas and take accountability. What we’re looking for

We’re looking for curious and intellectually proactive contributors, the kind of person who double-checks assumptions and plays devil’s advocate. Are you comfortable with ambiguity and complexity? Does an async, remote, flexible opportunity sound exciting? Would you like to learn how modern AI systems are tested and evaluated?

This is a flexible, project-based opportunity well-suited for:

  • Analysts, researchers, or consultants with strong critical thinking skills
  • Students (senior undergrads / grad students) looking for an intellectually interesting gig
  • People open to a part-time and non-permanent opportunity
About the project

We’re on the hunt for QAs for autonomous AI agents for a new project focused on validating and improving complex task structures, policy logic, and agent evaluation frameworks. Throughout the project, you’ll balance quality assurance, research, and logical problem-solving. This project opportunity is ideal for people who enjoy looking at systems holistically and thinking through scenarios, implications, and edge cases.

You do not need a coding background, but you must be curious, intellectually rigorous, and capable of evaluating the soundness and consistency of complex setups. If you’ve ever excelled in things like consulting, CHGK, Olympiads, case solving, or systems thinking — you might be a great fit.

What you’ll be doing
  • Reviewing evaluation tasks and scenarios for logic, completeness, and realism
  • Identifying inconsistencies, missing assumptions, or unclear decision points
  • Helping define clear expected behaviors (gold standards) for AI agents
  • Annotating cause-effect relationships, reasoning paths, and plausible alternatives
  • Thinking through complex systems and policies as a human would to ensure agents are tested properly
  • Working closely with QA, writers, or developers to suggest refinements or edge case coverage
How to get started

Apply to this post, qualify, and get the chance to contribute to a project aligned with your skills, on your own schedule. Shape the future of AI while building tools that benefit everyone.

Requirements
  • Excellent analytical thinking: Can reason about complex systems, scenarios, and logical implications
  • Strong attention to detail: Can spot contradictions, ambiguities, and vague requirements
  • Familiarity with structured data formats: Can read, not necessarily write JSON/YAML
  • Can assess scenarios holistically: What’s missing, what’s unrealistic, what might break?
  • Good communication and clear writing (in English) to document your findings

We also value applicants who have:

  • Experience with policy evaluation, logic puzzles, case studies, or structured scenario design
  • Background in consulting, academia, olympiads (e.g. logic/math/informatics), or research
  • Exposure to LLMs, prompt engineering, or AI-generated content
  • Familiarity with QA or test-case thinking (edge cases, failure modes, "what could go wrong")
  • Some understanding of how scoring or evaluation works in agent testing (precision, coverage, etc.)
Benefits

  • Take part in a flexible, remote, freelance project that fits around your primary professional or academic commitments
  • Participate in an advanced AI project and gain valuable experience to enhance your portfolio
  • Influence how future AI models understand and communicate in your field of expertise

title: Subsea Flexible Pipe Design Engineer and Subsea Flexible Riser Analysis Engineer
description:
Overview

Join Our Team and Shape the Future of Offshore Engineering!

In NOV SPS, part of the Fortune 500 company NOV, we power the industries that power the world. Our core business is engineering, manufacturing, and delivering high-quality flexible pipe systems for our clients around the world.

NOV Subsea Production Systems (NOV SPS) designs and manufactures flexible pipes and specific, innovative products for the offshore oil and gas industry. At our operations in Denmark (Brondby and Kalundborg) and in Brazil (Rio de Janeiro and Açu Port), we leverage superior engineering and state-of-the-art manufacturing technology to deliver subsea equipment to global contractors and oil companies.

We continuously push the boundaries of our capabilities and for this we are looking for an Engineer – Pipe System Design Engineering, to join our global team and support our growth in Brazil, following the increased demand for offshore flexible pipes at projects worldwide.

Your New Role

You will be part of our global and international Engineering department, based in either Rio de Janeiro or São João da Barra, Açu Port, Brazil, where we work on several major flexible pipe projects at a time in a multi-disciplinary environment. You will take part in a range of tasks in the projects, where you can leverage your skills as an engineer to succeed.

Subsea Flexible Riser Analysis Engineer

You will play a crucial role in designing our flexible pipe systems, from modeling the dynamic offshore environment and simulating the behavior of the structures to calculating loads and evaluating the integrity of flexible pipes and subsea structures. In collaboration with other engineering disciplines, you will be modeling all the components together as a system using the finite element analysis-based software Orcaflex, designing the whole subsea configuration and calculating loads to assess the integrity and feasibility of the different components like the pipe cross-section, the end-fittings, and subsea structures. You will design the configuration of the flexible risers whether it’s in free-hanging, lazy wave, or other configurations, defining required pipe lengths and ancillary components such as bend stiffeners and buoyancy modules.

You will receive comprehensive support and training to master the specifics of the role, and we will assign a buddy/mentor to get you started. Your key responsibilities will include:

  • Conducting comprehensive global analysis of flexible pipes and offshore structures under various extreme operating conditions.
  • Performing hydrodynamic and structural simulations to assess the impact of environmental forces, such as waves, currents, and tides.
  • Analyzing the mechanical behavior of flexible pipes, considering factors like bending, axial tension, compression, and torsion.
  • Evaluating extreme environmental conditions like 100-year events, operational fatigue life conditions, as well as installation scenarios to ensure a safe deployment and maintenance-free operation of the pipes for 20+ years.
  • Collaborating with multidisciplinary teams, including other engineering disciplines, our sales department, project management, supply chain, planning, operations, manufacturing, etc., to ensure efficient and successful project execution.
  • Collaborating and communicating with our customers, independent verification parties, installation contractors, and other external stakeholders.
  • Preparing detailed technical reports and documentation to communicate analysis results and recommendations for handling, installation and operation.
  • Ensuring compliance with industry standards (API Spec 17J and RP17B), regulations, and safety requirements.
About You

From the moment you start your career in NOV, we will support your personal and professional development. We seek engineers who can contribute their expertise and experience to our team. While we value diverse backgrounds, we have identified key skills and competencies that we believe will set you up for success in your new role:

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Ocean Engineering, Naval Architecture, Marine Engineering, or a related field.
  • Experience in structural analysis and dynamic simulation, preferably within the offshore industry.
  • Proficiency in finite element analysis software Orcaflex or similar.
  • Strong understanding of fluid mechanics, hydrodynamic loading, wave theory, fatigue analysis, and nonlinear behavior of materials.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to work effectively in a team environment.
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to present complex technical information clearly.
  • Fluent in both written and spoken English on a professional level.
Subsea Flexible Pipe Design Engineer

You will play a crucial role in designing our core product, the flexible pipe cross-section, ensuring manufacturability, material compatibility and the pipes’ structural integrity, analyzing and accounting for dozens of failure modes, and performing complex calculations with respect to flexible pipe properties and capacities. Since everything we do relates to the pipe cross section, as a pipe design engineer you will have a central role in our projects, and you will have close interfaces with most of our departments, including our other engineering disciplines focused on designing the riser system and specific components like the end-fittings, and ancillary components such as bend stiffeners and buoyancy modules, in order to design technically feasible and cost-effective flexible pipe solutions.

You will receive comprehensive support and training to master the specifics of the role, and we will assign a buddy/mentor to get you started. Your key responsibilities will include:

  • Conducting comprehensive local (cross-sectional) analysis of flexible pipes under various extreme operating conditions using in-house analysis- and FEA-based software and tools.
  • Performing structural analysis to assess the flexible pipe failure modes, technical feasibility and cost effectiveness.
  • Analyzing the mechanical behavior of flexible pipes, considering factors like bending, axial tension, compression, and torsion.
  • Evaluating extreme environmental conditions like 100-year events, operational fatigue life conditions, as well as installation scenarios to ensure a safe deployment and maintenance-free operation of the pipes for 20+ years.
  • Collaborating with multidisciplinary teams, including other engineering disciplines, our sales department, project management, supply chain, planning, operations, manufacturing, etc., to ensure efficient and successful project execution.
  • Collaborating and communicating with our customers, independent verification parties, installation contractors, and other external stakeholders.
  • Preparing detailed technical reports and documentation to deliver analysis results and recommendations for handling, installation and operation.
  • Provide technical support to factories concerning manufacturing deviations and non-conformity assessments on projects.
  • Ensuring compliance with industry standards (API Spec 17J and RP 17B), regulations, and safety requirements.
About You

From the moment you start your career in NOV, we will support your personal and professional development. While we welcome both newly graduated as well as experienced engineers to apply, we have identified some skills and competencies that we believe will set you up for success in your new role:

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Civil Engineering, Materials, or a related field.
  • Experience in structural analysis and project engineering.
  • Proficiency in finite element analysis and programming skills with Python and/or VBA.
  • Strong understanding of solid mechanics, fluid mechanics, fatigue analysis, thermodynamics, and nonlinear behavior of materials.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to work effectively in a team environment.
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to present complex technical information clearly.
  • Fluent in both written and spoken English on a professional level.
Why Join Us?

Flexible pipes are one of the most complex products in the offshore industries, and every pipe we deliver is custom engineered for the client’s specific needs and requirements, and for the specific environmental conditions whether it’s offshore Brazil, Australia, Africa, or in the North Sea. The job will provide a lifelong learning opportunity full of challenging, unique projects that are crucial to the world’s energy supply.

In NOV Subsea Production Systems, we are at the forefront of offshore engineering, delivering cutting-edge solutions that power the industries that power the world. Our team of experts is dedicated to pushing the boundaries of technology and ensuring the safety and reliability of offshore structures.

NOV is a large corporation with a multitude of career opportunities, offering a competitive salary and comprehensive benefits package and we are committed to ensuring a good work-life balance. Our main strength is our colleagues, our good social, supportive, and collaborative work environment that values innovation and continuous learning.

Business travel is to a limited extent part of the job and may happen in occasional opportunities to visit customers around the globe as well as other NOV sites/offices. More frequently, you will visit our factory in Açu Port, where you can see your designs come to life, provide your engineering expertise and support, and experience the pipes coiled up on reels the size of a two-story house being picked up by our customers and sailed to their destination.

Are you Interested?

We hope the above has sparked your interest and that you will become a new member of our team. If you have any questions, please don’t hesitate to apply for the position, we are more than happy to provide any additional information or clarification you may need along the selection recruitment process.

Apply Now and become a part of a company dedicated to innovation, excellence, and safety!

description:
Overview

Responsible for serving as the technical reference and accountable lead within the piping discipline, with a focus on leading modification projects for fleet units, while also driving long-term strategies, the review and development of technical guides and internal specifications, and action plans. This includes assessing and identifying improvements in business value, compliance, and technical safety to ensure enhanced fleet performance, aligned with best practices across the MODEC Group shared as common standards, as well as promoting research and development.

Responsibilities and assignments

We are looking for a Piping Principal Engineer to work in our Base in RIO DE JANEIRO, RJ developing activities such as:

  • Lead the development and validation of the piping scope for conceptual, basic, detailed design, and cost estimate phases for fleet unit modifications, ensuring that modifications meet MODEC/international standards and the Classification Society requirements.
  • Provide technical support and act as validator for specific Management of Change (MOC) cases across the fleet, as well as for Root Cause Analyses (RCA) and Technical Queries/Studies (TQ) related to the Piping discipline.
  • Analyze and guide the development of strategic documents related to the Piping discipline, such as philosophies, guides, and technical notes, in order to maintain fleet compliance with regulations, industry standards, and MODEC’s global policies.
  • Contribute to MODEC’s internal lessons-learned process, capturing and addressing improvement opportunities that can be applied to operating units as well as to new FPSOs under design, while maintaining communication channels with other entities within MODEC Inc.
  • Maximize business lifecycle value and ensure fleet performance enhancement by developing and researching new technologies, proposing KPIs, providing technical guidance in resolving Piping-related issues, and developing continuous improvement action plans.
  • Support internal, external, and regulatory audits by providing engineering technical expertise within the Piping discipline scope.
Requirements and qualifications
  • Bachelor’s degree in mechanical, chemical, or civil engineering is mandatory.
  • Minimum of 10 years of experience in industrial piping.
  • Prior experience in the O&G sector and FPSOs is expected.
  • Valid CREA registration is mandatory.
  • Postgraduate studies in areas related to the discipline of expertise are expected.
  • MBA or equivalent is a plus.
  • Advanced English is mandatory. Fluency is a plus.
  • Proficiency in 2D drafting software (e.g., AutoCAD) is mandatory.
  • Knowledge of 3D model visualization software (e.g., Navisworks) is expected.
  • Experience with piping stress analysis and related software (e.g., CAESAR II) is expected.
  • Experience with 3D modeling (e.g., AVEVA E3D) is a plus.
  • Experience with structural analysis and related software (e.g., ANSYS) is a plus.
  • Experience with CMMS software (e.g., SAP) is a plus.
Additional information

Being part of MODEC means being the PROTAGONIST of a CHALLENGING career and being in touch with the latest deep-water production systems, knowing that your career begins in BRAZIL, but your talent can take you anywhere in the WORLD.

If you want to be one of the greatest in the market, this is your opportunity!!

As a MULTICULTURAL company that respects DIVERSITY, we encourage PWD application in our process.

Process stages

Career without borders

If you are dynamic, committed, have an innovative spirit and want to work in a multinational company that is a reference in the oil and gas industry, embark on this journey with us.

We are MODEC, the largest independent operator of FPSO platforms in the world and we want to go further to offer the best technology and the best solutions for our customers and the market. Therefore, we invest in professionals who enjoy challenges and want to grow in a solid, ethical and multicultural company.

Working at MODEC means being in a global environment. Your career may start in Brazil, but your talent can take you around the world and open up new professional frontiers. We have over 50 years of experience in the oil and gas industry operating on five continents. We are very proud to have been in Brazil for 20 years and support the growth of the oil and gas sector.

title: Data Analyst
description:
Overview

This job is with United Nations, an inclusive employer and a member of myGwork – the largest global platform for the LGBTQ+ business community. Please do not contact the recruiter directly.

Result of Service: The Data Analyst reports to the Head of Brazil Office. He/She shall duly and timely perform his/her obligations, under this Terms of Reference. The consultant will work in close collaboration with UN-Habitat’s operational and technical teams.

Work Location

Rio de Janeiro, Brazil

Expected duration

Three (3) months, renewable

Duties and Responsibilities

Background: The main mandate of the United Nations Human Settlements Programme (UN-Habitat) is to promote sustainable development of human settlements and policies conducive to adequate housing for all. Within this framework, UN-Habitat supports central and state governments, local authorities and other partners for the implementation of the Habitat Agenda, the 2030 Agenda with the Sustainable Development Goals and the New Urban Agenda. UN-Habitat helps the urban poor by transforming cities into safer, more inclusive, compact, integrated, resilient and connected places with better opportunities where everyone can live with dignity. It works with organizations at every level, including all spheres of government, civil society, and the private sector to help build, manage, plan and finance sustainable urban development. The Regional Office for Latin American and the Caribbean – ROLAC – is based in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil. The Agency puts emphasis in developing and managing activities in the host country. Indeed, for the past years, UN-Habitat has expanded its portfolio in Brazil by working with the three tiers of government to support the formulation and implementation of more effective, sustainable, participative, and socially fairer urban economic, social, and environmental policies. To properly implement the projects in Brazil, a Data Analyst is required to ensure good execution of the work programme. Report to UN-Habitat Manager: The Data Analyst reports to the Head of Brazil Office, who will evaluate him/her.

Responsibilities

  • a) Assist in the elaboration and calculation of variables, indicators and other data and information.
  • b) Extract, process and analyse data from public databases and statistics – such as those produced by the Brazilian Institute of Geography and Statistics and other organizations – and present them in various formats (tables, graphs, charts).
  • c) Elaborate and/or support the creation of georeferenced information.
  • d) Revise all documents produced related to spatial data and information.
  • e) Participate and organize capacity building activities for UN-Habitat and government staff working in the implementation of UN-Habitat’s projects in Brazil.
  • f) Provide appropriate technical support to implement activities related to collection, production, analysis and management of data, information and urban indicators and support any other studies and research.
  • g) Provide information for the systematization and exchange of successful practices and experiences with other offices in the region and with headquarters divisions.
  • h) Provide inputs for the identification of project risks.
  • i) Document and maintain an orderly and accessible information file related to all activities undertaken.
  • j) Be responsible for the delivery according to deadlines for each task and conduct administrative and management activities to ensure that projects meet the objectives in terms of deadlines, budget and quality.
  • k) Document expert group meetings, training events and other activities related to the planning, development and implementation of ongoing and new projects.
  • l) Perform other duties which may be requested by the supervisors.
  • m) Participate in missions as requested. The consultant will be responsible for completing all courses and training activities that are indicated to him/her by his/her supervisor. The security course BSAFE, from UNDSS, is required to be accredited during the first month of employment. The consultant will be responsible for his/her own security, so the person should get familiarized with United Nations security mechanisms and comply with them according to the Framework of Accountability for the United Nations Security Management System.

Outputs/Work Assignment: The Data Analyst will support the implementation of projects according to the stated responsibilities. The consultant shall be paid a monthly allowance, upon presentation and approval by the Head of Brazil Office of monthly activities’ report.

Qualifications / Skills

Education Required:

  • A first-level university degree in Public Policy, Sociology, Political Science, Geography, Economics, Urban Studies, Statistics or related fields is required, or additional three (3) years of relevant experience to the post, beyond the requirement. Desired:
  • Postgraduate degree (Lato Sensu or Stricto Sensu) in Public Policy, Sociology, Political Science, Geography, Economics, Urban Studies, Statistics or related fields is desired.

Work experience:

  • Minimum six (6) years of experience in themes related to data analysis, reports and information for public policy, data visualization, data collection, processing and analysis is required.
  • Progressively responsible experience in project/programme management on urban related themes is required.
  • Previous experience within the UN System is desired.

Skills:

  • Good computer skills in Windows, Word, Excel, Outlook and Web search engines are required.
  • Knowledge of geographical information systems (GIS) software such as QGIS or ArcGIS is required.
  • Good command of programming languages such as R or Python is desirable.
  • Good handling of software, online platforms and other tools for data visualization is desirable.
  • Basic experience with platforms for sharing programming and version control such as GitHub or GitLab is desirable.
  • Good knowledge on project management methodologies is desirable.

Competencies

  • Professionalism: Experience working in an inter-institutional environment, project management, monitoring-evaluation; approaches and strategies regarding good urban governance and local and regional development.
  • Planning and organization: Professional approach to work, strong sense of responsibility, operate with minimal supervision; proven organizational skills and ability to manage a workload efficiently and within set deadlines.
  • Communication: Ability to write clearly and effectively; listen to others, interpret messages correctly and respond appropriately; show openness in information sharing and keep everyone informed; solid abstract reasoning skills together with a proven capacity to write documents for diverse audiences.
  • Teamwork: Ability to work with teams, demonstrate leadership, conflict management and consensus facilitation skills; ability to work in a multicultural and multi-ethnic environment, and to respect diversity; sensitivity to the main streaming of vulnerability; willingness and ability to work in difficult environments.
  • Knowledge Management: The person must know the processes, procedures, and norms of UN-Habitat, to guarantee an adequate quality of the activities described above, following the standards of the organization; propose formats and procedures that allow the efficient implementation of the activities related to the project development; ensure proper file maintenance and accessibility; prepare databases; share relevant technical information with staff; ensure materials are fit-for-purpose and delivered for posterior consultation; share information with the team and ensure privacy of content.

Languages:

  • English and French are the working languages of the United Nations Secretariat, and Spanish is the working language of the Regional Office.
  • For the post advertised, fluency in Portuguese and English is required. Working knowledge of Spanish is desirable.
Additional Information

Travel details: Applicable. The consultant must be available to travel to the places related to the activities in the country, if requested by the Head of Brazil Office. Missions will be coordinated and financed by UN-Habitat, according to the United Nations travel rules and guidelines.

Remuneration: SB-3/5 – BRL: 8,168.84 (net amount) UNDP Brazil Salary Scale

Notes: Appointment against this post is on local basis and only nationals from Brazil or external candidates who hold a permanent visa in Brazil may apply. The extension of this contract is subject to availability of funds and/or performance. Any contract extension is not automatic. It is required for all the curricular information to be inserted in the system, which may take a few hours. Only complete applications in English will be considered. All applications will be treated with the strictest confidence. Due to the volume of applications received, receipt of applications cannot be acknowledged individually. Only short-listed applicants will be contacted. Applications should be submitted through INSPIRA and must include all documents required at the system, please be ready to include the following information at the “Candidate Profile” (CP) at Inspira: covers memo, educational background with dates, professional experience, expertise and location preferences, other experience and expertise. title: Product Director, Feegow (100% remote-friendly within Brazil)
description:
Company Description

Welcome to the good side of tech

You might have heard about us but with a different name: Feegow, Doctoralia or Docplanner. The names are different depending on the country we are located in, but we are all part of Docplanner Group.

It all started over 12 years ago when we asked ourselves: is anyone in healthcare thinking about patients? We jumped in and we empowered patients by giving them access to leave and read reviews about their visit. We then provided doctors with the technology to manage bookings easily and save time, so they could devote themselves to what they always wanted: treating patients. And today is the day in which we ask you: wanna join us in the next step helping people live longer and healthier lives?

Where does Feegow fit here?

In 2022 Feegow joined the Docplanner Group, a health-tech company. We are dedicated to developing innovative solutions and promoting access to top-tier management for physicians seeking to take their practices to the next level, as well as managers in search of a robust solution that covers end-to-end operations. Our ultimate goal is to create a world where everyone can access high-quality healthcare.

Docplanner Group at scale

We are leaders in 13 countries so far, and more than 50 million patients trust us every month. 300.000+ specialists believe in us and our product, and so do leading venture capital funds such as Point Nine Capital, Goldman Sachs Asset Management and One Peak Partners. And yet, employing over 2.500 people all over the globe, we managed to keep the startup-mindset we started with over 12 years ago.

And why should you join us?

Because it feels good to tell your family and your friends how you made the world a little bit better. You go to bed knowing that what you do matters, and that your talents align with your beliefs.

We want to make the healthcare experience more human, and that starts with you being you. We believe that considering the diversity of human experience makes a better healthcare experience for all. We’re not just different: we embrace diversity. We will encourage you to come to work your whole self, and that includes not coming to the office at all if you prefer not to, as we\'re 100% remote-friendly.

Remote model: you can work 100% from home, but you are also welcome in our offices in Curitiba and Rio de Janeiro.

Job Description

Feegow is the leading Practice Management System (PMS) in Brazil for individual doctors & large clinics alike, and a highly strategic product for Docplanner Group, as a foundation to conquer the Brazilian market.

We are looking for a passionate and experienced Director of Product for Feegow to lead our product teams, drive innovation, accountability, and play a key role in our product\'s modernization. This is a remote-friendly role within Brazil, where you’ll foster collaboration between global teams, steer product development, and manage a talented product team. Your expertise in building a data-driven & business minded product culture whilst delivering fast & safe iterations, knowing when to go for PoCs & robust solutions based on the business appetite and product maturity will ensure the continued growth of Feegow and Docplanner Group.

What we expect from this position:

  • Inspire, lead and bring in PMS product vision to all product managers and teams.
  • Understand a complex environment where the teams have not only individual doctors and clinics that should be delighted with their Efficiency platform, whilst bringing them new value propositions like Visibility & Growth, as well as betting on AI as a door opener for exponential value.
  • Define with PMs the product strategy on every team, how it relates to the broader Brazilian strategy & Docplanner Tech & Product strategy.
  • Influence and establish a shared vision with other business areas as Sales, Operations and Marketing. Be a key stakeholder for Individuals and Clinics Business owners.
  • Ensure upcoming product needs and opportunities aligned with your Engineering Director and Country Managers to create a coherent Product & Tech Strategy and Roadmap.
  • Champion a hands-on approach to innovation by using a combination of Data, listening to the market, and “getting out of the building” to get first-hand customer/user insights.
  • Create a culture of decision-making based on insight, analysis and data across the business.
  • Work closely with our Global VP Product, on standardizing the objectives in clear indicators & tasks and bring transparency on ‘the plan’ across the whole company.
Qualifications
  • Minimum 3 years’ work experience as Product Director / GPM (managing and coaching a group of Product Managers)
  • Experience on B2B SaaS scale-ups
  • Solid experience in fast high-growth environment, change management, & business growth
  • A proven track record of delivering significant success, scaling and developing high performing digital products that impact business & delight customers
  • Expertise in the end-to-end product development lifecycle, agile and lean software development practices
  • An entrepreneurial mindset with outstanding organizational, communicative and leadership skills
  • Business savvy, holistic business acumen outside of Product Management and ability to assess product market fit
  • Analytical abilities and problem-solving skills
  • Experience in healthcare is a plus not a must
  • Experience in modernizing tech debt whilst delivering product value is a plus
  • Hands-on: In Docplanner, being a people manager does not mean only managing people, but being able to dive in the details of problems, opportunities & solutions.
Additional Information

What will you get in return?

Let’s talk money

  • A salary adequate to your experience and skills between R$37,000and R$44.500. Your salary will be, now and always, 100% transparent to you;

Benefits:

  • 100% remote-friendly within Brazil
  • Working hours are from Monday to Friday, from 9 am to 6 pm;
  • We have compensatory time off (Banco de Horas);
  • Food/Market Voucher;
  • Medical, Dental, and Group Life Insurance;
  • Pet Plan;
  • iFeel app, for emotional comfort;
  • Gympass for you and up to 3 people!
  • Creditas: Payroll loan services, eligible after 6 months of employment;
  • Stock Options- eligible after 6 months of employment (5 years grace period)
  • Birthday Day Off;
  • Daycare Assistance;
  • Partnership Club, with discounts ranging from teaching institutions, such as colleges and language learning services;
  • Referral Program offers up to R$600 per person who stays with us for more than 6 months;
  • Leave of Absence/Time-off: in the event of the passing of loved ones, we offer 10 days off; if your pet passes away, we offer 2 days. Got married? 7 days of rest! Did the baby arrive? We offer 30 days for Dads and 6 months for Moms;

Important: Docplanner is an international English-first company. Therefore, please be sure to send your CV in English

When you apply for our roles you receive equal treatment regardless of age, disabilities, gender reassignment, marital or civil partner status, pregnancy or parental status, race, colour, nationality, ethnic or national origin, religion or belief, sex, sexual orientation or any other dimension of human difference. If you require additional support in your recruitment process, we kindly encourage you to let us know. Behind those words you’re reading, there’s a person (hi!) who already helped a candidate by adapting the interviews, and now we’re lucky to have this person with us. So, even if you’ve never asked for it before, may this serve as a sign that, now, you can do so. We can only truly be equal if we adapt to each other.

title: Senior Manager, Legal Counsel
description:
Senior Manager, Legal Counsel

Department: Legal & Compliance

Employment Type: Fixed Term - Full Time

Location: Brazil

Description

FIFA27 will be established as the Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil, to work together with FIFA HQ in Zurich and globally, to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027 (FWWC2027).

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION

Reporting to FWWC2027 Head of Event Legal, and working alongside the FIFA Legal team in Zurich, the Senior Manager, Legal Counsel is responsible for the provision of legal support in connection with the organization and staging of FWWC27. This key position plays an integral part in ensuring the successful organization and staging of FWWC27. The successful candidate will be expected to pick up the responsibilities of the role and deliver results from the outset, working in a collaborative and constructive way across all functional areas connected to the delivery of FWWC27.

The role of Senior Legal Counsel for FWWC27 will be based in the Tournament HQ in Rio de Janeiro and is a full time role, but the term of employment is limited in length and will cease at the end of the FWWC27 once any necessary post-tournament requirements are fulfilled.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
  • Providing legal support to FIFA27 in connection with the organization and staging of FWWC27 across a broad range of legal areas, working alongside the FIFA Legal team in Miami.
  • Planning, setting up and implementing, in collaboration with the FIFA Legal team and FIFA Finance, the tax and corporate structure of FIFA27.
  • Assisting with all corporate, company secretarial and governance matters in respect of FIFA27, including legal, regulatory and FIFA institutional requirements and best practices.
  • Ensuring that the operation of FIFA27 and the staging and organization of FWWC27 complies with all applicable laws and regulations, including all federal, state and municipal laws and regulations.
  • Delivering all necessary legal advice, strategic direction and support during the operational phase, tournament time and wind-down phase of the FWWC27.

Advising, alongside the FIFA Legal team in Miami, on the implementation of the legal framework for the hosting and staging of FWWC27, including:

  • Advising on the implementation of the hosting documentation provided during the bidding process for FWWC27, including hosting agreements, host city agreements, stadium agreements, training site agreements, airport agreements, accommodation agreements and related contractual documentation;
  • Supervising the implementation of the guarantees provided by Brazilian government during the bidding process for FWWC27 across topics such as taxation, immigration, employment and customs; and
  • Supporting the Head of Legal and senior management in its discussions with the Brazilian government and CBF and on the establishment of a FWWC27 event law.

Additional specific areas of responsibility include:

  • Drafting and negotiating service provider agreements and any other contracts to be entered into by FIFA27 in connection with the organization and staging of FWWC27;
  • Managing any contentious matters and disputes that may arise in connection with FWWC27;
  • Advising FIFA and FIFA27 on employment and labour law matters, including drafting employment and human resources contracts, documentation and policies and dealing with employment and labour law disputes;
  • Managing external counsel; and
  • Supporting brand protection and anti-ambush marketing activities as part of the overall brand protection plan developed by FIFA.
  • Coordinating and working closely with other legal divisions within FIFA in relation to the hosting and staging of FWWC27, including in relation to media rights, TV production, content, music, technology, intellectual property, brand protection, sponsorship, marketing, corporate and institutional matters.
YOUR PROFILE
  • An experienced and skilled lawyer qualified in Brazil with at least 10+ years of experience either in a top firm, large corporate or sporting organization, with experience advising major multinational organizations on a wide range of legal issues.
  • Experience with Administrative and Regulatory Law, Contractual and Civil Law consultancy, Compliance and Data Protection is desirable.
  • Previous experience of legal experience in the sports industry is desirable, particularly experience with the hosting and staging of major sports events. Candidates with a demonstratable interest in the sports industry and a strong commercial legal background will also be considered.
  • Experience recruiting and managing a team.
  • Keen understanding of the various interests and demands of all key stakeholders of FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027 and a thorough appreciation of how the actions of FIFA27 could affect those interests.
  • Ability to create, develop and maintain strong and reliable relationships with FIFA Senior Management as well as external legal and commercial counterparts.
  • Strong IT skills, including MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint).
  • Capacity to advise the business when making key decisions through critical problem-solving skills and an ability to use sound judgement.
  • Entrepreneurial spirit, motivational leadership, effective negotiation skills, excellent communication skills and positive relationship-management skills.
  • Strong communication skills, both written and verbal.
  • A team player, willing to work to tight timelines.
  • Positive attitude, patience, and persistence.
  • Experience working within a multicultural and or multinational organization.
  • Qualified as an attorney in Brazil
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

title: Network Implementation Analyst – Mid-Level
description:
Who are we?

Equinix is the world’s digital infrastructure company, shortening the path to connectivity to enable the innovations that enrich our work, life and planet. A place where bold ideas are welcomed, human connection is valued, and everyone has the opportunity to shape their future. Joining our operations team means being at the center of everything – maintaining and evolving critical infrastructure that powers the digital world and delivers real impact for our customers, communities and society. You’ll find belonging, purpose, and a team that welcomes you—because when you feel valued, you’re empowered to do your best work.

Job Summary

We are seeking a Mid-Level Network Analyst to join our managed solutions team, supporting the implementation and maintenance of network environments for datacenter and enterprise clients. The ideal candidate will bring solid hands-on experience in core networking technologies and demonstrate a collaborative mindset to thrive in dynamic environments.

Responsibilities

  • Implement and support network infrastructure in datacenter and enterprise environments.

  • Configure and update switches, routers, firewalls, and load balancers.

  • Troubleshoot and resolve moderately complex network issues.

  • Document network configurations and operational procedures.

  • Collaborate with senior engineers on network projects and migrations.

Qualifications

  • Proven background in network engineering or administration within enterprise or datacenter settings.

  • Strong understanding of routing protocols, including OSPF and BGP.

  • Practical knowledge of VLANs, STP, trunking, and basic QoS.

  • Experience with firewalls (Fortinet, Palo Alto, or Cisco ASA).

  • Familiarity with load balancers (F5, Kemp, Citrix, or similar).

  • Knowledge of VPNs (IPsec), HSRP/VRRP, and troubleshooting tools (ping, traceroute, Wireshark).

  • Exposure to monitoring tools (Zabbix, PRTG, or similar).

  • Basic understanding of automation (Ansible or Python is a plus).

  • Awareness of cloud networking (AWS, Azure, or GCP).

  • CCNA or equivalent certification is highly desirable.

  • Intermediate English proficiency.

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Telecommunications, or related field (or equivalent experience).

  • Automação de testes e validações em integrações.
  • Conhecimento em monitoramento de logs e métricas (ELK, Grafana, Prometheus, etc.).

Nossa missão é formar uma nova geração de líderes capazes de fazer a diferença em suas vidas e contribuir para um mundo melhor. Pessoas que superam desafios diariamente, com otimismo e acreditando no legado que estamos construindo.

Nesse papel você será responsável por atuar na administração de registros e documentos escolares. Terá a função de operacionalizar os processos de matrícula e transferência, de organização de turmas e de registros do histórico escolar dos estudantes.

O Inspired se compromete em salvaguardar e promover o bem-estar das crianças e jovens e, se você se juntar ao nosso time, esperaremos o mesmo de você, assim como que se comprometa a realizar os treinamentos de safeguarding que consideramos pertinentes à sua função. Nosso desafio é escalar processos de análise de renda, apoiar instituições de ensino na gestão de bolsas e contribuir para que mais alunos tenham acesso à educação de qualidade.

Aqui, você terá a oportunidade de atuar em projetos que conectam diretamente processos operacionais e tecnologia de ponta , ajudando a garantir eficiência, qualidade e confiabilidade nas entregas aos nossos clientes.

  • Organização, atenção a detalhes e capacidade de lidar com múltiplas demandas simultâneas.

Na Educaopen, acreditamos em autonomia com responsabilidade . Trabalhamos em ciclos ágeis, equilibrando eficiência operacional com aprendizado contínuo. Valorizamos a colaboração, a clareza nos processos e o impacto direto das contribuições de cada pessoa no crescimento da empresa.

title: Condition Based Monitoring Engineer
description:
Our people enable continuous progress. Their commitment, collective expertise, and unique capabilities are the engine room behind SBM Offshore’s True. Blue. Transition. Now, see how a role change can develop you, and us, even more.

About Us:
SBM Offshore is the world’s deepwater ocean-infrastructure expert. Our work is already resulting in cleaner, more efficient energy production in offshore oil and gas. True. Blue. Transition. is our promise. It means continuing to enable decarbonization and support the energy transition, while diversifying our unique capabilities to help more blue economy industries grow and thrive sustainably.

You support the effective management and optimization of rotating equipment on SBM FPSOs by monitoring and analyzing machinery conditions. Your role is crucial in ensuring equipment reliability and operational efficiency through continuous condition-based monitoring, data analysis, and collaboration with various teams.

Responsibilities
  • Support Machinery Engineers and the Maintenance Team in managing the Condition-Based Program for rotating equipment on SBM FPSOs, including compressors, turbines, blowers, pumps, gearboxes, and motors;
  • Review and monitor rotating equipment conditions using vibration data, lube oil results, and other critical operating data to assess equipment health;
  • Manage the Vibration & Oil Analysis Database and support the issuance of recommendations, consolidating inputs from third parties for the Offshore crew;
  • Input actions in the Computerized Maintenance Management System;
  • Follow-up on recommendations execution and effectiveness;
  • Perform continuous vibration analysis on equipment with installed Machinery Monitoring Systems;
  • Set up pre-warnings and alerts to proactively identify potential issues and necessary actions;
  • Collaborate with Operations and Maintenance Personnel, Technical Support Team, and Region Planners to prioritize repairs for identified equipment deficiencies;
  • Assist in troubleshooting by analyzing vibration data and other key machine parameters;
  • Provide vibration and oil analysis history to support root cause analysis efforts;
  • Offer guidance to the Technical Support Team and System Leads on machinery conditions during task risk assessments and gate reviews;
  • Identify and justify the purchase of major predictive equipment spare parts;
  • Provide technical assistance for root cause analysis related to ICSS failures and recommend remedial actions.
Education
  • High Level of Safety Awareness and good sense of economics;
  • Offshore survival and medical desirable/required.
Experience
  • Advanced knowledge in the field of Machinery Condition monitoring;
  • Good knowledge of Bently Nevada System 1 or ADRE;
  • Rotor dynamic knowledge;
  • Oil & Gas Experience - FPSO experience preferred;
  • Able to work autonomously and in multi-disciplinary teams;
  • Must have a proactive approach in combination with a problem-solving attitude;
  • Good analytical skills and ability to meet deadlines;
  • Effective communication and organizational skills, self-motivated, enthusiastic and able to work as a team member and communicate effectively with onshore and offshore staff at all levels;
  • Experience with Rotating machinery;
  • Minimum 5 years experience in the condition monitoring;
  • Must be autonomous and with good team spirit;
  • Good communication skills in English, both written and spoken;
  • Ability to manage several activities in parallel, combined with flexibility and strong organization;
  • Ability to travel internationally (short term), including offshore.

As part of our team, you will help shape one of Microsoft’s fastest-growing cloud services. Your work will directly impact Copilot, enabling personalized, context-aware experiences that empower millions of users across Microsoft 365.

You will collaborate closely with software engineers, product managers, and researchers to design, implement, and evaluate models and algorithms that continuously adapt and improve based on user interactions and feedback. You will leverage advanced machine learning and information retrieval to predict and optimize memory content selection, representation, and lifecycle management.

You will work at the forefront of applied AI and machine learning, shaping the future of intelligent productivity tools. You will contribute to a culture of innovation, continuous learning, and experimentation.

The Substrate Core Substrate team powers the infrastructure that underpins Microsoft 365’s most critical services and Copilot. We are a high-impact, forward-looking team focused on building intelligent, scalable, and cost-efficient platforms that enable Microsoft to deliver world-class productivity experiences to billions of users. Our mission is to drive operational excellence and innovation across the M365 fleet by leveraging AI, automation, and deep platform integration.

Your core mission will be to deliver exciting innovation in Microsoft Copilot. Microsoft Copilot is revolutionizing how people work and has created an unprecedented opportunity to advance the state-of-the-art in a way that benefits millions of people.

More About Your Responsibilities

We are seeking candidates with research skills and the desire to pursue the cutting edge in model development that pushes technological boundaries. We are looking for candidates with interest and experience in language model training, large language model evaluation, and quality assessment. In particular we would like a candidate that has a passion for understanding what makes an AI solution work and how to measure its performance.

We are looking for candidates who are creative, self-driven, curious, people-oriented and comfortable defining a path through ambiguity towards high-level goals. The successful applicants will collaborate closely with people across Microsoft’s product teams and Microsoft Research to see their ideas realized in products and services that are used worldwide, as well as to contribute back to the scientific community and beyond (e.g. via presentations, publications, media interviews, and similar). Come to define, design, and deliver what enterprise cloud productivity means.

As a Data Scientist , you will help transform how Copilot features are evaluated and improved. Your team will deliver end-to-end experimentation, evaluation, and insights to Copilot engineers, PMs, and fellow scientists. You’ll work on the data generation platform that creates algorithms and ML pipelines for simulating user actions and datasets that reflect real-world usage and user preferences and develop metrics that go beyond accuracy – capturing nuance, intent, and satisfaction. You’ll work on scalable pipelines that support offline evaluations for Copilot Search, BizChat, Connectors, and Agents (DAs). This opportunity will allow you to dive deep into Copilot technologies, shape how AI quality is measured at scale, build critical skills in the AI-era, and rapidly grow your career.

By applying to this position, you will be considered for multiple similar positions within our organization for an invitation-only virtual interview day. Position specifics, including hiring team, location, and position details, will be determined following the interview process.

The Talent Acquisition department hires qualified candidates to fill positions which contribute to the overall strategic success of Howard University. Hiring staff “for fit” makes significant contributions to Howard University’s overall mission.

At Howard University, we prioritize well-being and professional growth.

Here Is What We Offer

  • Work-Life Balance: PTO, paid holidays, flexible work arrangements
  • Financial Wellness: Competitive salary, 403(b) with company match

Join Howard University and thrive with us!

Job Purpose

Reporting to the Founding Director, the purpose of this position is to provide day-to-day leadership for all Center for Journalism & Democracy (CJD) staff while a permanent Executive Director search is conducted. The interim Executive Director will be responsible for implementation and oversight of Center programs at Howard and at its campus partners at various HBCUs. The interim Executive Director will be responsible for operationalizing the vision of the Founding Director, supervising Center staff and its day-to-day operation, and provide guidance to all members of the team. This position will help the Center fulfill its mission: To bolster the field of journalism in service of our multiracial democracy by supporting the teaching and practice of historically informed investigative reporting at Howard University and across the constellation of historically Black colleges and universities (HBCUs). The Center provides academic and financial support to students, faculty and news organizations located at Howard University and the nation’s largest journalism programs located at HBCUs.

Supervisory Authority

Responsible for providing supervision for multiple functions within a department. Formally plans, assigns, directs, and coordinates the work of these functions. Typically, responsible for performing some non-supervisory duties in addition to supervisory responsibilities. Performs staff evaluations and makes recommendations regarding pay and/or performance.

Nature And Scope

Internal contacts include executives, administrators, faculty, students, and staff of the university at large. External contacts include alumni, consultants, representatives from other colleges and universities, visitors, and the general public.

Principal Accountabilities

  • Provide strategic, holistic, high-level oversight and direction for the Center
  • Works closely with the Chief of Staff and Business Manager to manage grant spending and tracking for the CJD’s multi-million dollar grant portfolio
  • Works closely with the Chief of Staff, Business Manager and Development Manager to supervise the development and monitoring of grant proposal budgets and grant reports, ensuring alignment with the University advancement team and relevant grant accounting offices.
  • Creates, in collaboration with division heads, budgets for programming
  • Lead Center staff and directors in developing and implementing programs and ensure alignment across the Center’s strategic pillars
  • Identify and execute strategic partnerships within and outside of the university
  • Develop and execute fundraising campaigns in partnership with the Development Manager
  • Serve as spokesperson to represent the Center externally in public, professional, and community activities
  • Foster an inclusive and productive team culture
  • Create a space for professional development of team members
  • Ensure that the work of the Center is aligned with the Founding Director’s vision and proceeds in a timely and fiscally responsible manner
  • Set clear, measurable goals to direct the Center’s ongoing work and develop systems to evaluate progress towards those goals
  • Lead the development and launch of new projects as appropriate for the Center.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

Core Competencies

  • At least 10 years of experience leading and managing a team of 10+ individuals.
  • Demonstrated ability to organize and bring together a team in pursuit of common, measurable goals
  • Familiarity with journalism and investigative reporting; journalism experience preferred.
  • Proven success in managing multiple, complex, high-profile projects.
  • Demonstrated success performing and leading in a high growth/startup environment.
  • Fundraising experience
  • Experience developing systems and processes in support of implementing a high-level vision.
  • Comfort with developing and managing budgets, including management of intake and use of philanthropic funds.
  • Proven experience in successfully navigating and building partnerships across large, complex organizations.
  • Willingness to provide and receive direct, constructive feedback

  • Ability to exercise discretion and ensure a high-level of confidentiality.
  • Ability to establish and maintain effective and harmonious work relations and work collaboratively across functions, levels, and departments toward shared objectives.

O que nos move?

Claro, a paixão por esportes é indiscutível, mas também somos grandes amantes de inovação constante! Na LiveMode, nossa missão é Transformar e Crescer o Esporte , e nossos valores são o combustível que nos move no dia a dia. Acreditamos que crescer exige inconformismo, ambição e consistência. Na LiveMode, o futuro já está em movimento — e quem não acompanha, fica pra trás. Por isso, tratamos tecnologia com urgência: testamos, aprendemos e aplicamos com velocidade.
