title: Senior Manager, Legal Counsel
description:
Description

FIFA27 will be established as the Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil, to work together with FIFA HQ in Zurich and globally, to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027 ("FWWC2027").

Department: Legal & Compliance

Location: Brazil

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION

Reporting to FWWC2027 Head of Event Legal, and working alongside the FIFA Legal team in Zurich, the Senior Manager, Legal Counsel is responsible for the provision of legal support in connection with the organization and staging of FWWC27. This key position plays an integral part in ensuring the successful organization and staging of FWWC27. The successful candidate will be expected to pick up the responsibilities of the role and deliver results from the outset, working in a collaborative and constructive way across all functional areas connected to the delivery of FWWC27. The role of Senior Legal Counsel for FWWC27 will be based in the Tournament HQ in Rio de Janeiro and is a full time role, but the term of employment is limited in length and will cease at the end of the FWWC27 once any necessary post-tournament requirements are fulfilled.

Key responsibilities

  • Providing legal support to FIFA27 in connection with the organization and staging of FWWC27 across a broad range of legal areas, working alongside the FIFA Legal team in Miami.
  • Planning, setting up and implementing, in collaboration with the FIFA Legal team and FIFA Finance, the tax and corporate structure of FIFA27.
  • Assisting with all corporate, company secretarial and governance matters in respect of FIFA27, including legal, regulatory and FIFA institutional requirements and best practices.
  • Ensuring that the operation of FIFA27 and the staging and organization of FWWC27 complies with all applicable laws and regulations, including all federal, state and municipal laws and regulations.
  • Delivering all necessary legal advice, strategic direction and support during the operational phase, tournament time and wind-down phase of the FWWC27.

Advising, alongside the FIFA Legal team in Miami, on the implementation of the legal framework for the hosting and staging of FWWC27, including:

  • Advising on the implementation of the hosting documentation provided during the bidding process for FWWC27, including hosting agreements, host city agreements, stadium agreements, training site agreements, airport agreements, accommodation agreements and related contractual documentation;
  • Supervising the implementation of the guarantees provided by Brazilian government during the bidding process for FWWC27 across topics such as taxation, immigration, employment and customs; and
  • Supporting the Head of Legal and senior management in its discussions with the Brazilian government and CBF and on the establishment of a FWWC27 event law.

Additional specific areas of responsibility include:

  • Drafting and negotiating service provider agreements and any other contracts to be entered into by FIFA27 in connection with the organization and staging of FWWC27;
  • Managing any contentious matters and disputes that may arise in connection with FWWC27;
  • Advising FIFA and FIFA27 on employment and labour law matters, including drafting employment and human resources contracts, documentation and policies and dealing with employment and labour law disputes;
  • Managing external counsel; and
  • Supporting brand protection and anti-ambush marketing activities as part of the overall brand protection plan developed by FIFA.
  • Coordinating and working closely with other legal divisions within FIFA in relation to the hosting and staging of FWWC27, including in relation to media rights, TV production, content, music, technology, intellectual property, brand protection, sponsorship, marketing, corporate and institutional matters.

Your profile

  • An experienced and skilled lawyer qualified in Brazil with at least 10+ years of experience either in a top firm, large corporate or sporting organization, with experience advising major multinational organizations on a wide range of legal issues.
  • Experience with Administrative and Regulatory Law, Contractual and Civil Law consultancy, Compliance and Data Protection is desirable.
  • Previous experience of legal experience in the sports industry is desirable, particularly experience with the hosting and staging of major sports events. Candidates with a demonstratable interest in the sports industry and a strong commercial legal background will also be considered.
  • Experience recruiting and managing a team.
  • Keen understanding of the various interests and demands of all key stakeholders of FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027 and a thorough appreciation of how the actions of FIFA27 could affect those interests.
  • Ability to create, develop and maintain strong and reliable relationships with FIFA Senior Management as well as external legal and commercial counterparts.
  • Strong IT skills, including MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint).
  • Capacity to advise the business when making key decisions through critical problem-solving skills and an ability to use sound judgement.
  • Entrepreneurial spirit, motivational leadership, effective negotiation skills, excellent communication skills and positive relationship-management skills.
  • Strong communication skills, both written and verbal.
  • A team player, willing to work to tight timelines.
  • Positive attitude, patience, and persistence.
  • Experience working within a multicultural and or multinational organization.
  • Qualified as an attorney in Brazil
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.
Seniority level
  • Mid-Senior level

  • Contract

  • Acts as the primary contact during the execution of the project

  • Experience coordinating cross-functional technical teams and managing customer/vendor relationships.
  • Track record of identifying and mitigating project risks
  • Experience in managing project timelines, budgets, and scope, with a focus on successful project delivery.
  • In-depth knowledge of Network services and delivery processes.
  • Ability to drive projects and liaise with multiple teams and stakeholders.
  • Knowledge of technical documentation and change management practices.

We\'re all about diversity. We operate in 200 countries and speak 60 different languages and cultures. We\'re really proud of our inclusive environment. Professional Development: Level up your skills with our training platforms, including LinkedIn Learning!

Competitive Benefits: Competitive benefits that make sense with both your local market and employment status.

SITA is a Equal Opportunity Employer. We value a diverse workforce. In support of our Employment Equity Program, we encourage women, aboriginal people, members of visible minorities, and/or persons with disabilities to apply and self-identify in the application process.

title: Clinical Psychiatrist
description:
Join Howard University and thrive with us!

Job Purpose

The Clinical Psychiatrist will work as a key member of our multi-disciplinary wellness team at the Howard University College of Medicine’s Center for Spiritual Health and Wellness, providing essential mental health services to our diverse medical student population. They will assess, diagnose, and treat a wide range of psychiatric disorders, using evidence-based therapeutic interventions and programs to promote wellness. The psychiatrist position is an in-person, part-time position (two half-day sessions per week).

Supervisory Authority

The psychiatrist will not have supervisory authority.

Nature And Scope

Works collaboratively and professionally in a multidisciplinary setting. Interacts with students, staff and faculty within the College of Medicine and University Counseling services. Is a member of the team at the Howard University College of Medicine’s Center for Spiritual Health and Wellness.

Principal Accountabilities
  • Conduct comprehensive mental health assessments to identify students’ mental health needs, using a variety of methods such as interviews and psychometric tests.
  • Formulate individualized treatment plans for students, based on their unique needs, and update these plans as necessary throughout the course of treatment.
  • Provide evidence-based psychiatric treatments, such as cognitive-behavioral therapy (CBT), dialectical behavior therapy (DBT), psychodynamic therapy, or other relevant therapeutic modalities.
  • Coordinate care with the Director of the Wellness Center and the clinical psychologist.
  • Facilitate group therapy sessions, workshops, and wellness seminars as needed, on topics such as stress management, mindfulness, and coping with mental health issues.
  • Document all patient care or other clinical activity appropriately and in a timely fashion in the Electronic Medical Record or approved medical record systems.
  • Participate in ongoing professional development and training activities to stay current with the latest advancements in the field of psychiatry.
  • Provide crisis intervention and management as necessary.
  • Develops, collaborates, or participates in clinical research in the Department of Psychiatry and Behavioral Sciences; to the extent possible.
  • Promotes adherence and actively participates in the Health Sciences Compliance Program, the Howard University Code of Ethics and the Health Sciences Standards of Conduct.
  • Attends annual and periodic mandatory Compliance Program training including HIPAA Privacy training.
  • Participates in activities that promote adherence to federal healthcare program requirements.
  • Adheres to the requirements of the HIPAA Privacy Policies and Procedures.
  • Maintains licensure status in DC and continuing education to maintain a strong knowledge base within the profession.
  • Evaluate clients’ emotional, behavioral and mental state through discussion, observation and analysis.
  • Identify mental disorders and determine best treatments, inclusive of therapy, nutrition, stress management, and medications.
  • Administer, score and analyze psychiatric tests and track clients’ progress.
  • Coordinate with external healthcare professionals when hospitalization is required.
  • Advise patients on how to cope with mental diseases and emotional breakdowns.
  • Assumes other duties and responsibilities that are related and appropriate to the position.
  • The above responsibilities are a general description of the level and nature of the work assigned to this classification and is not to be considered as all-inclusive.
Core Competencies
  • Knowledge and experience in Clinical Psychiatry, including development, implementation, and supervision of clinical programs or services, and knowledge and experience in a broad range of evidence-based psychiatric treatments, assessments, and understanding of psychiatry standards and practices.
  • Understanding of clinical research methods and experience in clinical research.
  • Ability to exercise independent judgment that follows ethical guidelines and College of Medicine procedures.
  • Excellent ability to communicate verbally and in writing in English.
  • Ability to establish and maintain effective and harmonious work relationships with residents, students, colleagues, staff, physicians, Hospital and University officials and employees, patients, family members, and the general public.
  • Must demonstrate collaboration, accountability, respect, excellence, and service.
  • Works with team members and peers in and outside of their immediate work group to create an exceptional experience for patients, students and other visitors; partners to achieve departmental/institutional results.
  • Accepts responsibility for actions to provide health care and allied functions in a highly efficient and compassionate manner; reflects Howard values.
  • Embraces diversity; cares holistically for those served; maintains patient privacy with meticulous care and keeps information confidential.
  • Anticipates student needs, presents as a model representative of the institution and maintains high standards of care while seeking improvement.
  • Behaves in a friendly, resourceful and professional manner towards all encountered; treats patients, students and visitors with the care they expect for themselves.
  • Maintains licensure and registration for medical license, DEA and controlled substances.
Minimum Requirements
  • Satisfactory completion of a Medical Doctorate (M.D.) or Doctor of Osteopathic Medicine (D.O.) and a residency program in psychiatry.
  • Board certification in psychiatry by the American Board of Psychiatry and Neurology.
  • Active District of Columbia (D.C.) License to practice psychiatry.
  • Active DEA and Controlled Substance licenses and registrations.
  • Four (4) years of responsible work experience in psychiatry.
  • A great bedside manner and the ability to remain calm, empathetic and patient while interacting with patients who suffer from severe mental disorders.
Compliance Salary Range Disclosure

Expected Pay Range: $120 per hour

title: Surveyor I
description:
The Surveyor I is an entry or junior-level position for new graduates and/or those candidates with less than five (5) years of experience in an applicable industry. The Surveyor I, under a direct supervisor, performs work involving conventional surveying practices. The primary function is to develop the ability to effectively examine and report on vessels and other marine structures during and after construction relative to compliance with the applicable requirements for maintaining the vessel in Classification with ABS and meeting associated statutory and special service requirements related to Safety of Life at Sea, Loadline, Tonnage, Cargo Gear and Pollution Prevention Certification.

What You Will Do (with the assistance and guidance of an experienced ABS Surveyor):

  • Acts as a professional specialist for the organization in the application of related rules, regulations, requirements, concepts, principles, and processes.
  • Performs routine surveys on classed vessels, platforms, or other marine structures and at manufacturers for classification and compliance with statutory requirements.
  • Prepares technically accurate and timely reports of inspections and surveys performed.
  • Engages in contact with clients to resolve problems within areas of expertise.
  • Maintains survey files in an orderly and up-to-date manner in the area of responsibility.
  • Develops the skills necessary for the administration of office procedures and monitoring of business performance at an assigned port.
  • Through broader and more technically challenging work assignments, the individual must develop a thorough understanding of field operations, policies, methods, and procedures.

What You Will Need:

Education and Experience

  • Qualifications from a tertiary institution within a relevant field of engineering or physical science (minimum two (2) years program); or
  • Qualifications from a marine or nautical institution and relevant seagoing experience as a certificated ship officer, and
  • Proficiency in the English language commensurate with the scope of statutory certification and services and, before assignment, with their future work.
  • Appropriate certification and/or licenses in areas of specialization may be required.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • Ability to develop a working knowledge of ABS Rules, Guides, statutory regulations, and related instructions, as well as the ABS Employee Safety Policy.
  • Ability to read engineering plans and have a basic understanding of shipbuilding practices and vessel operations.
  • Ability to perform surveys in the prescribed format.
  • Knowledge of computer programs or software packages related to job responsibilities.
  • Knowledge of related technical interfaces required for group project work.
  • Knowledge of ships' engineering systems and machinery.
  • Ability to communicate, orally and in writing, pertinent information relative to assigned area of technical expertise.
  • Ability to analyze problems and propose solutions.
  • Responsiveness to customers and the ability to work well with others.
  • Ability to become familiar with the ABS Health, Safety, Quality, and Environmental Management Systems.

Physical Requirements:

  • Where allowed by local laws, a pre-employment physical examination is mandatory.
  • The role of surveyor/auditor requires sufficient physical strength, stamina, agility, and both visual and auditory acuity to perform the listed duties effectively.
  • The ability to climb vertical ladders up to nine meters and navigate steep steps is essential.
  • Shall be capable of working at heights on various staging and lifting equipment.
  • Shall be able to maneuver in tight spaces and work inside confined areas for extended periods, including kneeling and crawling.
  • The role may involve exposure to industrial environments, potential injury risks, extreme weather conditions, and demanding physical activities.
  • Shall be able to lift at least 25 lbs. / 11.34 kgs.
  • The use of small tools and the wearing of Personal Protective Equipment (PPE), in accordance with ABS safety procedures, may be required.
  • Where allowed by local laws, the surveyor will be required to successfully complete an annual physical that will recertify the individual can perform the physical actions required.

Reporting Relationships:

Will report to the Principal, Senior, or Surveyor-in-Charge of the assigned port. This position does not have any direct reports.

Desde dezembro de 2015, a SPDM/PAIS é responsável, em parceria com a Secretaria Municipal de Saúde do Rio de Janeiro, pelo gerenciamento do Hospital Municipal Pedro II .

A infraestrutura do Hospital conta com dez andares, nos quais estão distribuídos os serviços de emergência e de Unidade de Tratamento Intensivo (UTI) adulta, pediátrica e neonatal; maternidade; clínica médica, cirurgia-geral e bucomaxilofacial, neurocirurgia, psiquiatria, pediatria e ortopedia. Exames de imagem (raio X, tomografia, ultrassonografia, eletrocardiografia, ecocardiografia) e laboratoriais também são realizados na unidade.

Devido à grande população de idosos da Zona Oeste, região assistida pelo Hospital Municipal Pedro II (HMPII), há duas Enfermarias destinadas ao atendimento desse público.

O Centro de Tratamento de Queimados é outro diferencial entre os serviços oferecidos, e que dispõe de uma UTI exclusiva para prevenir infecções, que podem ser muito graves para quem está com queimaduras.

Além disso, a unidade conta com a Coordenação de Emergência Regional (CER) Santa Cruz, que possui 39 leitos, e tem como objetivo absorver as demandas de menor complexidade, deixando o HMPII liberado para os casos de risco iminente de morte, necessidade de cirurgia urgente e/ou internação. Um diferencial deste CER é o fato de possuir atendimento especializado em Psiquiatria e Obstetrícia.

title: System Software Engineer - Ubuntu Networking
description:
System Software Engineer - Ubuntu Networking

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors.

We are hiring a System Software Engineer for Ubuntu Networking to focus on the connectivity of Ubuntu in a wide range of circumstances, from cloud to server to desktop and IoT. We would like to strengthen the tooling, services, documentation, robustness, security and clarity of Linux network abstractions to provide fast, reliable and secure connections for Ubuntu.

The network stack is one of the most critical aspects of any operating system where stability, reliability and uptime are paramount. Its ease of use and reliability contribute to Ubuntu's success from IoT, Desktop, Server to the Cloud. We are expanding our Foundations team to focus our efforts on this essential function and are looking for people passionate about lower level technologies involved in an operating system's network stack.

As a Linux System Engineer, you will maintain and integrate core components involved in the network stack of the Ubuntu Distribution. You will be discussing design with other team members, upstream projects, mentor less senior engineers and participate in code reviews and design reviews. You will also be working with other teams to ensure architecture decisions improve the overall performance and experience of Ubuntu.

Location: This role will be based remotely in the AMERICAS region

The role entails

  • Collaborate proactively with a distributed team
  • Shape software-define networking products for evolving data center architectures to meet ever-increasing bandwidth, reliability, security, and interoperability demands
  • Write high-quality, well-designed and well-documented software
  • Debug issues and produce high-quality code to fix them
  • Collaborate proactively with a globally distributed organization
  • Contribute to technical documentation to make it the best of its kind
  • Display technical leadership internally, towards our partners, and in the open source communities
  • Influence open-source projects and communities
  • Shape innovative product strategies
  • Work from home with global travel 2 to 4 weeks a year for internal and external events

What we are looking for in you

  • Deep understanding and passion for Linux networking, from kernel to user space
  • Professional experience with computer networks, including virtual networks, distributed systems as well as understanding of hardware offloading technologies.
  • Interest in systemd-networkd, NetworkManager, ModemManager, iwd, conman, bluez, iproute2, Open vSwitch, WireGuard and similar software components
  • Fluency in at least one of Golang, C/C++, Rust or Python
  • Experience with Linux (Debian or Ubuntu preferred)
  • Interest in packaging software for Debian and Ubuntu
  • Exceptional academic track record from both high school and university
  • Undergraduate degree in a technical subject or a compelling narrative about your alternative chosen path
  • You love technology and working with brilliant people
  • You are passionate, curious, flexible, articulate, and accountable
  • You value soft skills and are passionate, enterprising, thoughtful, and self-motivated
  • Ability to travel internationally twice a year for company events up to two weeks long

What we offer colleagues

  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long-haul company events

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer. We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

Juntos, resolvemos desafios complexos em grande escala, enquanto continuamos comprometidos em tornar o mundo um lugar mais inclusivo e melhor para todos e para o nosso planeta. O(a) Coordenador(a) de Lançamentos será o ponto focal entre a Diretoria de Supply Chain e as áreas de Marketing, Business Development/Trade, Comercial e Operações, garantindo uma integração estratégica e operacional para o sucesso dos lançamentos de produtos. Principais Atividades:

  • Atuar como principal interface e facilitador(a) da comunicação entre Supply Chain e as áreas de Marketing, Business Development/Trade, Comercial e Operações, assegurando que todas as informações e decisões sobre novos lançamentos sejam compartilhadas de forma clara e adequada. Colaborar ativamente com as áreas em questão durante a construção e refinamento da previsão de vendas para novos lançamentos, garantindo que as premissas de mercado e as capacidades de Supply Chain estejam alinhadas.
  • Conduzir reuniões de alinhamento periódico com as partes interessadas para discutir o progresso dos lançamentos, identificar gargalos e propor soluções colaborativas. Combinar análises de demanda com visão fábrica, tanto no que diz respeito à capacidade produtiva (insumos, capacidade linha, reatividade etc.) como riscos atrelados às variações de venda.

  • Desafiar e validar as projeções de vendas, utilizando dados históricos, tendências de mercado e inteligência de negócio para garantir a maior assertividade possível.
  • Monitorar de perto a performance de vendas dos novos lançamentos versus as previsões estabelecidas, identificando desvios e analisando suas causas. Preparar e apresentar relatórios de performance pós-lançamento, destacando sucessos, aprendizados e oportunidades de melhoria contínua.
  • Coletar feedback das áreas envolvidas sobre o desempenho do produto no mercado, a fim de gerar insights para futuros lançamentos e ajustes na estratégia.
  • Projetar, desenvolver e implementar ferramentas robustas e eficientes para o acompanhamento e monitoramento de novos lançamentos (ex: dashboards em Power BI, planilhas avançadas).   • Excelência em Comunicação:Habilidade para construir relacionamentos, negociar e influenciar diferentes níveis hierárquicos e áreas.
  • Visão Estratégica e Analítica:Capacidade de analisar dados complexos, identificar tendências, propor soluções e tomar decisões baseadas em insights.

Overview

Chief of Staff/Associate Director of Research (COS/ADS) role at Inside Higher Ed. The COS/ADS serves as a key member of the Institute for Advanced Study at Howard University executive leadership team. The incumbent will coordinate activities (operations and research), manage the Director’s strategic and research agendas, and work with senior leaders to develop action plans, initiate, lead, monitor, and evaluate projects, ensure resource availability, and implement the Founder’s directives and initiatives.

Job Purpose

Reporting to the Director, the Chief of Staff/Associate Director of Research (COS/ADS) serves as a key member of the Institute for Advanced Study at Howard University executive leadership team. The COS/ADS is responsible for the central coordination of activities (operations and research) and for ensuring the timely flow of information to and from the Director. The incumbent will be responsible for managing the strategic agenda and the research agenda of the Director, and for working with other senior executive leaders to develop the Director’s action plans, to initiate, lead, monitor, and evaluate projects, ensure that key projects emanating out of the Howard University Institute for Advanced Study have the resources needed, and ensures implementation of the Founder’s directives and initiatives.

Supervisory Authority

The COS/ADS will manage three staff members who will be hired at the Institute: Research Manager, Administrative Assistant, and Social Media Coordinator.

Nature And Scope

Internal contacts include executives, administrators, faculty, students, and staff of the University at large. External contacts include alumni, consultants, representatives from other colleges and universities, visitors, and the general public.

Principal Accountabilities
  • Work closely with the Director and key stakeholders to oversee the development and execution of the Institute and the Director’s other projects
  • Provide principal management support to the Founder
  • Liaise with the Director and the finance staff to develop and maintain the center's budgetary planning
  • Supervise three full-time staff members: the Social Media Coordinator, the Administrative Assistant, and the Research Manager
  • Assist with the management and coordination of Institute-wide projects
  • Represent the Founder in meetings concerning organizational planning, research, and communication
  • Manage the flow of communication into and out of the Office of the Director to ensure consistency
  • Plan with the Director the conceptual and creative direction of communication products
  • Develop and build on relationships with all employees for increased efficiency and responsiveness of existing operations, and help define new operational strategies by working with the Director and other executives on special projects
  • Serve on various Center committees as appointed by the Director
  • Work closely with the Administrative Assistant to ensure the Director’s public and media appearances are run efficiently and cohesively
  • Develop presentations, reports, correspondence, and proposals on behalf of the Director
  • Coordinate special programs, meetings, projects, and purchases
  • Respond to inquiries and manage the flow of confidential information with respect to personnel matters, grievances, and correspondence
  • Support the Director in identifying internal and external challenges and opportunities with the bodies of work; serve as a key problem solver and innovator
  • Develop and build on relationships with all Institute employees for increased efficiency and responsiveness of existing operations, and help define new operational strategies
  • Hire, train, and manage a research team of part-time and full-time research assistants led by a Research Manager
  • Conducts historical and empirical research on subject matters for the Director and reviews manuscripts
  • Facilitate, in concert with the Director, communication and follow-up with university leadership
  • Perform other duties as assigned by the Director based on needs
Core Competencies
  • Communicate with discretion and confidentiality to internal and external stakeholders
  • Represent Director with designated business/community leaders, elected/government officials, university/college leaders, and the general public
  • Assist in the cultivation of relationships across the university and with other center partners across HBCUs and field practitioners

title: Cybersecurity Solutions Engineer
description:
Job Description

The Cybersecurity Solutions Engineer is responsible for the administration, optimization, and continuous improvement of security technologies, while also serving as a Tier 3 escalation point for complex security incidents. This role bridges advanced incident response with hands-on engineering of cybersecurity tools, ensuring seamless integration, effective threat detection, and rapid response capabilities. Acting as an extension of external Tier 1 and Tier 2 security operations, the engineer plays a critical role in enhancing the organization’s overall security posture through proactive monitoring, tool fine-tuning, and strategic incident handling.

Security Tools Administration

  • Administer and optimize security tools, including SIEM, EDR/XDR (Microsoft Defender), firewalls, vulnerability management, email and identity security solutions.
  • Ensure seamless integration of security tools with IT and cloud environments for continuous monitoring and threat detection.
  • Maintain security policies, configurations, and automation rules to improve operational efficiency and reduce false positives.
  • Manage log sources, data ingestion pipelines, and correlation rules within SIEM to enhance security visibility.

Security Operations & Incident Response

  • Act as a Tier 3 escalation point for security incidents requiring advanced investigation and resolution.
  • Conduct deep-dive forensic analysis and threat-hunting activities to detect and mitigate sophisticated threats.
  • Support the SOC team and external Tier 1 & Tier 2 analysts by providing expertise on complex security incidents.
  • Enhance and refine incident response playbooks, ensuring effective collaboration across all security layers.
  • Align incident response efforts with cybersecurity frameworks such as MITRE ATT&CK, NIST CSF, and ISO 27001.

Threat Intelligence & Vulnerability Management

  • Analyze threat intelligence feeds and proactively adjust defenses based on evolving attack techniques.
  • Coordinate vulnerability assessments, collaborate with IT teams, and track remediation efforts to mitigate risks.
  • Perform proactive threat-hunting activities to identify potential security gaps before they are exploited.
  • Ensure compliance with patch management policies and security best practices.

REQUIREMENTS :

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
  • At least 3 years of experience in security tools administration, incident response, or security operations.
  • Experience in listed companies, large-scale enterprises, or multi-geographical organizations is a plus.
  • Deep knowledge of Microsoft Security solutions.
  • Hands-on experience with SIEM, EDR/XDR, firewalls, and security automation tools.
  • Proficiency in threat intelligence, forensic analysis, and malware analysis.
  • Strong understanding of network security, log analysis, and cloud security.
  • Experience with vulnerability management solutions.
  • CISSP, GCIA, GCIH, Microsoft Certified: Security Operations Analyst, or equivalent.
  • Availability to travel internationally

SOFT SKILLS :

  • Problem-solving and organizational skills.
  • Strong ability to explain technical issues to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Experience working cross-functionally with IT, cloud, and development teams, as well as external security partners.
  • Attention to Detail.
  • Resilient.
  • Willingness to stay current with evolving cybersecurity threats and technologies.
  • Ability to manage multiple security incidents and projects simultaneously.

Join to apply for the Global Head of Cloud Alliances role at Canonical

Get AI-powered advice on this job and more exclusive features.

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in more than 80 countries and very few office based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder led, profitable and growing.

We are hiring a Head of Cloud Alliances to lead business development and partnerships with the global public clouds. As the publisher of Ubuntu, Canonical is already a trusted partner with the leading guest OS and select services for the major hyperscalers. We have a large portfolio of open source software on the cloud marketplace for enterprise customers, and are looking to expand our global cloud partnerships.

Reporting to the VP of Global Alliances, the Global Head of Cloud Alliances will lead teams that bring innovation to the public cloud platforms, joint go-to-market with public cloud sales communities and marketplaces, and our global customer and partner contracts. They will work closely with cloud partners, from engineering to product management and marketing, to deliver open source solutions at scale for their cloud customers.

Our Cloud Alliance team builds trusted relationships with partners at all levels, from joint technical work to executive strategy. Their goal is to increase Canonical market share in the cloud ISV ecosystem, develop cloud channel sales, evangelize the partnership and lead all business interactions. The Global Head of Cloud Alliances will own the strategy, sell-to, sell-through and sell-with motions with all cloud partners, as well as promotion of our cloud related activities - from campaigns, to strategic opportunities and cloud related events.

Our company is largely distributed, this role can be based anywhere in the Americas or EMEA.

The role entails

  • Taking ownership of Canonical's global cloud partner strategy, leading efforts to forecast, driving bookings, and growing revenue worldwide
  • Building strong, cross-functional relationships across teams to ensure a unified approach to technology and market execution
  • Inspiring and guiding teams to achieve accelerated revenue growth with Cloud partners, continually refining and evolving strategies for success
  • Establishing and nurturing executive-level relationships with key partners, laying the foundation for long-term success and mutual growth
  • Steering our offering from concept to execution, aligning product management and marketing strategies while scaling success through our global sales organization

What we are looking for in you:

  • Exceptional academic track record from both high school and university
  • Undergraduate degree in a technical subject
  • Confidence to respectfully speak up, exchange feedback, and share ideas without hesitation
  • Track record of going above-and-beyond expectations to achieve outstanding results
  • Leadership and commitment to skills development and mentorship
  • Passion for technology evidenced by personal projects and initiatives
  • The work ethic and confidence to shine alongside motivated colleagues
  • Exceptional leadership and presentation skills, capable of energizing teams and stakeholders while delivering compelling data-driven narratives
  • Excellent interpersonal skills, curiosity, flexibility, and accountability
  • Appreciative of diversity, polite, and effective in a multi-cultural, multi-national organization
  • Thoughtfulness and self-motivation
  • Result-oriented, with a personal drive to meet commitments
  • Ability to travel internationally twice a year for company events up to two weeks long
  • An in-depth understanding of open source technologies, Ubuntu, and the competitive ecosystem, with an eye for identifying opportunities that others might miss.
  • Autonomous, disciplined, and proactive—take ownership, and deliver exceptional results

Nice to have

  • A track record in alliance and indirect sales management, with an ability to build partnerships that drive success
  • Solid experience in the Public Cloud sector, coupled with an understanding of the evolving landscape of technology and innovation.
  • Experience with Linux (Debian or Ubuntu preferred)

What we offer colleagues

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards

Descrição da oportunidade

Sabemos que carreiras podem ser tão diferentes quanto as próprias pessoas. Por isso, na EY, você terá a liberdade , as ferramentas e as condições para se desenvolver e construir uma carreira tão única quanto você.

Em FSO, estamos construindo um mundo de negócios melhor apoiando organizações a prosperar em uma era de mudanças rápidas. Oferecemos serviços em todas as disciplinas tributárias e combinamos nosso conhecimento e experiência com as pessoas e as melhores plataformas de tecnologia; e isso nos torna um parceiro ideal para as necessidades relacionadas a impostos sobre transações, impostos internacionais e questões fiscais relacionadas a pessoas, conformidade e relatórios, entre outros.

Oportunidade disponível para atuação híbrida no escritório de São Paulo/ Rio de Janeiro/ Porto Alegre...

Qual será o seu papel nesse propósito?

Como uma pessoa Gerente de Tributos você será parte da área de Tax com foco na indústria financeira, atuando em consultoria tributária, auxiliando as empresas em projetos de compliance e consultoria em impostos diretos (CSLL e IRPJ) para bancos e seguradoras, assumindo as seguintes responsabilidades:

  • Liderar equipes de auditoria na revisão dos cálculos e identificação de riscos e exposições;
  • Realizar a revisão e preparação do imposto diferido e respectivas projeções de acordo com as normas ASC 740 e IAS 12, bem como Tax Provision e reconciliação da alíquota efetiva;
  • Realizar a revisão e preparação da apuração do imposto de renda e contribuição social seguindo as normas e legislações aplicáveis;
  • Realizar pesquisas e responder as consultas tributárias de clientes;
  • Atuar na revisão e preparação da ECF (Escrituração Contábil Fiscal) e ECD (Escrituração Contábil Digital);
  • Desenvolver e manter relacionamentos de trabalho produtivos com os funcionários de clientes e avaliar sua satisfação;
  • Supervisionar o trabalho de campo diário, informar aos supervisores a situação do trabalho e gerenciar o desempenho da equipe;
  • Desenvolver as pessoas, por meio da delegação efetiva de tarefas e fornecimento de orientação à equipe, fornecendo feedback e treinamento com relação ao desempenho;
  • Contribuir com ideias/opiniões para as equipes de impostos e ouvir/ser receptivo/a ao ponto de vista de outros membros da equipe;
  • Ter um entendimento das linhas de serviço da EY e buscar/incentivar, de forma ativa, as pessoas da equipe a contribuírem com ideias e identificar oportunidades de aplicação dos serviços da empresa.

Se você possui os requisitos abaixo, essa oportunidade pode ser sua:

  • Graduação em contabilidade, direito, administração ou economia;
  • Experiência consistente em projetos que envolvam apuração de impostos diretos, desenvolvendo estratégias de planejamento tributário alinhadas às necessidades globais de cada cliente;
  • Profundo conhecimento em impostos diretos (IRPJ e CSLL – lucro real e lucro presumido) e na preparação e revisão de ECF e ECD;
  • Inglês avançado;
  • Habilidade avançada na comunicação verbal e escrita;
  • Habilidade no trabalho em equipe e liderança.

Poderá ser um diferencial, caso você tenha os seguintes requisitos:

  • Vivência em projetos de suporte a auditoria, compliance e planejamento Tributário;
  • Conhecimento em Digital TAX.

A EY é uma das maiores empresas de serviços do mundo, em Auditoria, Consultoria, Impostos, Estratégia e Transações, orientados à Tecnologia. Com presença em mais de 150 países, aqui você terá a oportunidade de viver as experiências excepcionais que só a EY pode oferecer, com alcance global, cultura inclusiva e tecnologia para se tornar a sua melhor versão.

Aqui, acreditamos que a força que impulsiona a inovação vem da diversidade de pessoas e ideias, por isso nossas vagas são destinadas para todas as pessoas. Oferecemos o suporte necessário, provendo acessibilidade para pessoas com deficiência, aplicação de metodologia de trabalho assistido para pessoas com deficiência intelectual e neurodiversas, assim como incentivamos a divulgação de vagas afirmativas como o Programa de Trainees exclusivo para PcD.

A EY também conta com o grupo de afinidade Abilities+ que promove ações internas para a construção de um ambiente mais inclusivo.

Quer se sentir desafiado/a, motivado/a e valorizado/a todos os dias? Inspirar mudanças e deixar um legado? Faça parte do nosso time e ajude-nos na construção de um mundo de negócios melhor!

Marine Surveyor – Casualty and Machinery Investigations

Be the energy behind change. Join ABL Group.

ABL Group is a leading global independent energy and marine consultant working in energy and oceans to de-risk and drive the energy transition across the renewables, maritime, and oil and gas sectors, offering the deepest pool of expertise across marine and engineering disciplines in more than 300 locations globally.

Working as a core member of our team in Brazil, you will investigate marine incidents and assess damage caused to vessels. The job holder will be expected to conduct investigations onboard vessels and at our clients’ sites across Brazil.

  • Support loss prevention activities such as condition surveys and risk assessments when required.
  • Other duties as assigned.

What are we looking for?

  • Chief Engineer (STCW CoC Class 1), Master Mariner, or former IACS Class Surveyor.
  • Minimum of 5 years’ sea service and / or survey / technical experience in the shipping or offshore sector.
  • Previous experience of conducting surveys for insurers (e.g, P&I and H&M) is preferred.
  • Strong knowledge of vessel machinery systems, marine operations, and international regulations.
  • Able to produce technical reports written in English.

Further Information
You must have the right to live and work in Brazil. We would especially like to hear from potential candidates based in the following areas: Salvador, Fortaleza, Belem or Manaus.

The job holder will be required to undertake onshore and offshore client attendances at short notice in Brazil and international locations.

At Carta, our employees set out on a mission to unlock the power of equity ownership for more people in more places. We believe that the problems we solve today unlock the opportunities of tomorrow. You will join our engineering team of passionate learners, builders, experts, and leaders to define and implement Carta's next generation of products, platforms, and infrastructure. You'll collaborate closely with key stakeholders in Product, Business, and Design. Carta's software engineers contribute in many different ways: sometimes we are shipping new product features, architecting simple and maintainable systems, or training the organization on new technology solutions. You will make your own mark here.

About You

At Carta, you’re not just an employee. You’re a builder who is creating infrastructure that accelerates innovation and empowers more ownership. Cartans are helpful, relentless, unconventional and kind; representing Carta’s Identity Traits. They work collaboratively and cross functionally to challenge the status quo; working towards a common goal of creating more owners in the private markets.

  • You have 5+ years of experience as a Software Engineer.

The Interview Process

First, one of our recruiters will call you to tell you more about the job and company. You'll then meet an Engineering leader who will discuss your opportunities at Carta and explore your experience, skills, and goals. We’ll then ask you to show off your skills with a real-world take home exercise (we do not do LeetCode-style interviews, no one will quiz you on writing a doubly-linked list). Finally, you'll have back-to-back conversations with Carta team members on a wide range of topics, including communications and collaboration, coding efficacy and techniques, and systems design.

A Supergasbras é uma empresa do grupo holandês SHV Energy, líder mundial na distribuição de GLP, com mais de 100 anos de experiência. Nosso negócio é levar energia limpa e eficiente para milhões de brasileiros, seja nas suas casas, comércios, indústrias ou agronegócio. Os mais de 76 anos de atuação no Brasil nos posiciona como uma das principais distribuidoras nacionais de GLP - comercializamos cerca de 1,5 milhão de toneladas do produto por ano com aproximadamente 20% de participação de mercado.

Desenvolvemos uma série de projetos com foco em transformação digital, experiência do cliente, inovação e desenvolvimento sustentável do negócio. Nossa estratégia é conseguir através da confiança e integridade, ser a melhor empresa de Energia do Brasil para nossos clientes, parceiros, colaboradores e acionistas, com responsabilidade socioambiental.

Diversidade e inclusão é uma prioridade de negócios para a Supergasbras. Valorizamos e acreditamos no desenvolvimento de pessoas, tanto no contexto profissional como pessoal, tendo como estratégia a equidade de gênero, inclusão de pessoas com deficiência, respeito a todas as orientações sexuais e luta contra a discriminação racial nas diferentes camadas da sociedade.

O que faz a gente ser Super?

Somos uma empresa que valoriza as pessoas e tudo o que elas representam: a energia das ideias, da contribuição, da parceria e da colaboração. Por isso, nos dedicamos a construir um ambiente de trabalho propício ao desenvolvimento humano e profissional dos nossos colaboradores, sempre incentivando a interação, a participação ativa e o crescimento. Gostamos de quem acrescenta, porque acreditamos que o sucesso vem da soma da energia com a colaboração.

E o que nós fazemos exatamente?

Somos uma empresa do Grupo SHV Energy, líder mundial na distribuição de GLP e uma das principais distribuidoras de gás LP no Brasil, com mais de 75 anos de atuação. Possuímos o mais moderno parque engarrafador da América Latina e contamos com mais de 20 unidades industriais distribuídas pelo país, de norte a sul. Nossos mais de 4 mil colaboradores nos enchem de orgulho pelo que somos e pelo que fazemos, levando energia para mais de 10 milhões de famílias brasileiras, alcançando locais onde nenhum outro tipo de energia consegue chegar. Além disso, atendemos mais de 60 mil clientes empresariais, desde pequenos comércios até grandes indústrias, incluindo o agronegócio.

title: Consulting X-Force Incident Response Consultant Professional NO City, BR
description:
Overview

Information and Data are some of the most important organizational assets in today’s businesses. As a Security Consultant, you will be a key advisor for IBM’s clients, analysing business requirements to design and implement the best security solutions for their needs. You will apply your technical skills to find the balance between enabling and securing the client’s organization with the cognitive solutions that are making IBM the fastest growing enterprise security business in the world.

Your role and responsibilities

As a Senior Incident Response Consultant for the IBM Security X-Force Incident Response (X-Force IR) team in Latin America, you will be responsible for the growth and delivery of X-Force IR services. You will lead a team of consultants who are responding to high profile cybersecurity incidents within our clients’ enterprise networks. You will work with our clients to proactively prevent and detect future cybersecurity incidents. You will serve as a trusted advisor to our clients, helping to shape their cybersecurity program. You will collaborate with internal IBM stakeholders to provide integrated solutions to our clients’ most challenging problems.

  • Lead a team of consultants responding to high-profile cybersecurity incidents within clients’ enterprise networks.
  • Direct the growth and delivery of X-Force IR services in Latin America.
  • Work with clients to proactively prevent and detect cybersecurity incidents; help shape and mature their cybersecurity programs.
  • Collaborate with internal IBM stakeholders to deliver integrated security solutions.
  • Act as a trusted advisor to clients on incident response, threat intelligence, and security program maturity.

In this role you will have demonstrated skills in various elements of Incident Response, conducting computer intrusion investigations, and have a strong foundation in cyber security policy, operations and best practices; ideally in large enterprise environments. You will have proficiency with leading EDR tools as well as familiarity with forensic analysis tools such as X-Ways, EnCase Forensic or FTK and live response analysis. Furthermore, familiarity with Windows and Linux enterprise environments and systems such as Active Directory, Office 365, FWs, IPS/IDS, SIEMs, etc. is required. Excellent written and verbal communication skills are required. When not responding to breaches, you will conduct enterprise threat hunting, help clients develop incident response plans, facilitate tabletop and purple team exercises as well as provide other strategic security services related to incident response.

Required education

Bachelor's Degree

Required technical and professional expertise

Significant hands-on experience with hardware/software tools used in incident response, computer forensics, network security assessments, and/or application security.

  • Years Experience with assessing and developing enterprise-wide policies and procedures for IT risk mitigation and incident response.
  • Experience leading incident response teams and managing tasks across all phases of an engagement.
  • Experience managing a team of consultants with skills similar to those described below.
  • Capable of working independently as well as providing leadership on internal projects and client engagements.
Forensic Analysis & Incident Response Skills
  • Ability to forensically analyze both Windows & Unix systems for evidence of compromise.
  • Proficiency with industry standard forensic tools such as EnCase, FTK, X-Ways, Sleuthkit.
  • Experience performing log analysis locally and via SIEM/log aggregation tool.
  • Experience hunting threat actors in large enterprise networks and cloud environments.
  • Experience with using and configuring Endpoint Detection & Response (EDR) tools.
  • Demonstrate an understanding of the behaviour, security risks and controls of common network protocols.
  • Demonstrate an understanding of common applications used in Windows and Linux enterprise environment. Familiarity with Active Directory, Exchange and Office365 applications and logs.
  • Familiarity with the tools and techniques required to analyse & reverse diverse protocols and data traversing a network environment.
  • Familiarity with cloud computing platforms like IBM Cloud, AWS, GCP or Azure
  • Proficient in writing cohesive reports for a technical and non-technical audience.
Strategic Assessment Expertise
  • Examine and analyze available client internal policies, processes, and procedures to determine patterns and gaps at both a strategic and tactical levels. Recommend appropriate course of action to support maturing the client’s incident response program and cyber security posture.
  • A strong familiarity with various security frameworks and standards such as ISO 27001/2, PCI DSS, NIST800-53, 800-171, and applicable data privacy laws and regulations.
  • Demonstrated experience with planning, scoping, and delivering technical and/or executive level tabletop exercises, with a focus on either tactical or strategic incident response processes.
  • Ability to incorporate current trends and develop custom scenarios applicable to a client.

• Low-level operating system knowledge, including automation and performing administrative tasks.

• Scripting or programming experience, preferably in a language commonly used for DFIR such as Python or PowerShell.

• Ability to work with data at scale such as using Splunk / ELK.

• Expertise working with shell programs such as grep, sed and awk to process data quickly.

• Working experience with virtualisation and cloud technology platforms like IBM Cloud, AWS, GCP & Azure.

• Communication skills: able to communicate fluently in English or/and Spanish.

Preferred technical and professional experience
  • Diverse understanding of cyber security related vulnerabilities, common attack vectors, and mitigations.
  • Capable of developing strategic level incident response plans as well as tactical-focused playbooks.
  • Ability to manage tasks and coordinate work streams during incident response investigations.
  • Communication skills: able to communicate fluently in English or/and Spanish.
ABOUT BUSINESS UNIT

IBM Consulting is IBM’s consulting and global professional services business, with market leading capabilities in business and technology transformation. With deep expertise in many industries, we offer strategy, experience, technology, and operations services to many of the most innovative and valuable companies in the world. Our people are focused on accelerating our clients’ businesses through the power of collaboration. We believe in the power of technology responsibly used to help people, partners and the planet.

In a world where technology never stands still, we understand that, dedication to our clients success, innovation that matters, and trust and personal responsibility in all our relationships, lives in what we do as IBMers as we strive to be the catalyst that makes the world work better.

Overview

Este profissional deve assegurar que os participantes adquiram conhecimentos teóricos e práticos para operar com segurança em cenários de perfuração e controle de poços.

The Well Control Instructor is responsible for delivering Well Control training in accordance with IADC WellSharp standards (Introductory, Driller, and Supervisor levels – Surface and Subsea). This professional must ensure that participants acquire the theoretical knowledge and practical skills required to operate safely in drilling and well control scenarios.

Principais Responsabilidades

  • Ministrar aulas teóricas e práticas de Controle de Poço conforme o currículo oficial do IADC WellSharp.

  • Elaborar relatórios de desempenho, registro de frequência e resultados dos alunos no sistema da IADC e nos controles internos.

  • Assegurar a atualização contínua dos materiais didáticos, simuladores e recursos de treinamento, em alinhamento com a versão vigente do programa.

  • Participar de auditorias internas e externas, contribuindo para a manutenção da acreditação do centro de treinamento.

  • Colaborar com a equipe de instrutores e suporte técnico no desenvolvimento e aprimoramento dos cursos.

A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a brMalls, em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.

Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Care Natural Beauty | Grupo Granado abre as portas para você!

Um Gerente de Loja apaixonado por varejo, beleza limpa e experiência do cliente . Você será responsável por liderar a operação da loja, garantindo um ambiente acolhedor, organizado e inspirador para os clientes e sua equipe. Seu papel é transformar cada visita à loja em uma jornada sensorial e emocional, promovendo um atendimento consultivo e autêntico.

  • Garantir a organização da loja, em geral.
  • Gerenciar com a equipe a reposição de produtos no salão de vendas;
  • Cuidar da decoração/disposição de produtos e realizar as trocas da vitrine;
  • Controlar e manter estoque: pedidos de produtos ao CD, conferência, estocagem de produtos, entrada de notas fiscais no sistema e emissão de notas fiscais referentes as saídas de produtos destinados (brindes, perdas, uso e consumo, testes, dentre outros);
  • Cumprir metas mensais de vendas com o objetivo de melhorar a produtividade, mantendo os índices de produtividade elevados;
  • Prestar atendimento na venda de kits para empresas/clientes e organização da entrega;
  • Manutenção geral da loja, incluindo solicitação de pintura, reparos, troca de lâmpadas, manutenção de ar condicionado, etc.;
  • Garantir a conciliação do caixa/movimento da loja por tipo de recebimento (cheques, dinheiro, cartão de crédito);
  • Realizar depósitos diários do caixa na conta da empresa;
  • Gerenciar o trabalho da equipe, garantindo cumprimento das obrigações trabalhistas;
  • Ministrar treinamentos teóricos e práticos;
  • Realizar processos de seleção de equipe, com apoio do RH.
  • Ensino Superior completo em Administração de Empresas, Marketing, Cosmetologia, Estética ou áreas afins;
  • Atuação como Gerente em redes varejistas;
  • Experiência anterior com cosméticos será considerada diferencial;
  • Ambiente integrado, alegre e positivo , onde a colaboração faz parte da rotina.
  • Vale-Refeição para curtir bons momentos e conversas descontraídas enquanto saboreia suas refeições.
  • Plano de saúde, odontológico e seguro de vida , porque cuidar de você e da sua família é prioridade. Afinal, mente sã em corpo são é o que importa!
  • Total Pass , para manter o corpo em movimento e a energia sempre lá em cima.
  • Descontos exclusivos nos produtos que você já ama: Granado, Phebo e Care Natural Beauty.
  • Ambiente que estimula a criatividade e o aprendizado contínuo , com apoio ao seu desenvolvimento por meio do nosso Programa de Educação Continuada — incluindo subsídios para cursos de aperfeiçoamento, graduação, pós-graduação e idiomas.
  • Parcerias com instituições de ensino e idiomas , como Estácio e Open English, para facilitar ainda mais sua jornada de desenvolvimento.
  • Programa de Participação nos Resultados , valorizando quem cresce e constrói junto com a gente.
É muita história para contar...

Desde o século XIX a Granado atravessa gerações encantando seus consumidores com produtos de qualidade e com uma pegada sustentável. São mais de 150 anos e, desde sua fundação, a marca sempre soube manter valores sólidos e estar atenta às necessidades de seu tempo. Cresceu e rejuvenesceu sem perder a essência.

Em 1930, a Perfumaria Phebo foi fundada em Belém do Pará, com fragrâncias marcantes, originais e de alta qualidade. Esta tradição, aliada ao seu conhecimento, ousadia e personalidade forte, alçou a Phebo ao topo das marcas de cosméticos mais respeitadas do mercado brasileiro, tornando-se sinônimo de luxo, excelência olfativa e qualidade.

Com uma proposta que valoriza o equilíbrio e o consumo consciente, recentemente a CARE se uniu à Granado e à Phebo para oferecer uma experiência de autocuidado transformadora, integrando ciência, tecnologia e sustentabilidade.

Nossa rica história centenária ajuda a construir um futuro inovador. Estamos presentes em cada produto desenvolvido; em cada loja inaugurada no Brasil e no exterior; em cada embalagem diferenciada e em cada olhar comprometido com o bem-estar das pessoas, com a segurança no local de trabalho e com a preservação do meio ambiente.

Juntas, Granado, Phebo e CARE representam a harmonia entre história e futuro, tradição e renovação, convidando seus consumidores a viverem jornadas únicas de bem-estar e beleza responsável.

title: Assistente de Operações (Marketing Digital)
description:

Buscamos um profissional organizado e detalhista para atuar na execução e monitoramento de processos digitais. Essa pessoa será responsável por inserir, revisar e ajustar informações em sistemas conforme diretrizes estabelecidas, garantindo que tudo esteja alinhado com os objetivos definidos.


A posição exige atenção a detalhes, disciplina na execução de tarefas repetitivas e capacidade de interpretar contextos de mercado para pequenas tomadas de decisão dentro dos processos estabelecidos.


Se você gosta de trabalhar com fluxos bem definidos, tem facilidade em lidar com sistemas e aprende rápido novas ferramentas, essa vaga pode ser ideal para você.

• Executar processos digitais conforme diretrizes estabelecidas.

• Monitorar informações e manter os fluxos atualizados.

• Ajustar execuções com base no contexto e sazonalidade do mercado (exemplo: identificar tendências como períodos de alta demanda para determinados produtos).

• Manter a organização e a precisão dos dados inseridos.

• Adaptar-se ao uso de diferentes softwares e sistemas, conforme necessário.

• Seguir fluxos operacionais sem necessidade de inovação constante, garantindo consistência na execução.


Requisitos:

• Facilidade para aprender e operar diferentes softwares e sistemas.

• Perfil organizado e atento a detalhes.

• Gostar de seguir processos e executar tarefas com consistência.

• Capacidade de interpretar contextos e adaptar pequenas decisões dentro das diretrizes estabelecidas.

• Boa comunicação e disciplina no cumprimento de prazos.

• Não é necessário experiência prévia em marketing digital, apenas disposição para aprender e executar com precisão.


Diferenciais (não obrigatórios, mas valorizados):

• Experiência com qualquer função que envolva execução operacional (back-office, suporte técnico, processos administrativos, logística, etc.).

• Interesse por negócios e comportamento do consumidor.

• Facilidade com análise de informações e padrões de mercado.


O que oferecemos:

• Ambiente estruturado, com processos bem definidos.

• Treinamento para operação dos sistemas e ferramentas utilizados.

• Oportunidade de aprendizado contínuo no ambiente digital.

• Possibilidade de crescimento dentro da área operacional.

Instead of rigid,disconnected software modules, ourassistants gain skills over time — from handling simple reschedules to managing complex intake, referrals, and medication refills. Patients experience a natural,empathetic interaction, while providers gain a system that is reliable, transparent, and continually improving. Our goal is to deliver a concierge experience forevery patient, and a scalable path to automation for every clinic.


About the Role

This role is an opportunity to join a high-impact team with tremendous growth opportunities. As a Senior Software Engineer, you will be responsible fordeveloping and maintaining mission-critical systems that power healthcare operations and interoperability for over 60 clinics and health systems.

At Health Note, we’re not building new AI models — we’re using services to deliver digital

assistants that act like trusted members of the care team. These assistants grow new skills over time, handle complex patient-facing workflows safely andreliably, and transform healthcare operations into a continuous improvement process. The result is not just reliable automation, but a human and empatheticexperience that patients and providers trust.

As part of a cross-functional team, you’ll collaborate with product managers, solution engineers, and client experience managers to create world-class, AI-enabled solutions. You’ll shape architectural decisions, integration patterns, and developer workflows so that AI isn’t just “bolted on,” but thoughtfullyincorporated into our platform.

This opportunity is ideal if you want to take the next step in your career and join a growth-stage organization focused on healthcare — while working at thefrontier of AI-enabled software development.

We’re a fully distributed, remote-first, fast-growing startup. Our engineering team is spread from UTC-3 to UTC-7 and we rely heavily on strong asynchronouscommunication. Occasionally, you’ll need to flex to sync up with teammates across time zones.

Our cutting-edge stack is full-stack Typescript leveraging NestJS, React, Remix, Tailwinds,GraphQL, PostgreSQL, Redis, Pulumi, all on AWS. Our architecture isservice oriented and managed in a Monorepo.

  • Design, implement, and maintain highly scalable and performant servicesand applications.
  • Integrate LLMs and AI services into production systems, with attention tosafety, observability, performance, and cost effectiveness.
  • Build abstractions, APIs, and internal tooling that make it easier for otherengineers and product teams to leverage AI responsibly.
  • Continually improve the codebase and test coverage through refactoring,automated testing, CI/CD, and strong developer productivity practices.

title: Professor de italiano
description:
Faça parte da comunidade de professores que está transformando o ensino de idiomas no Brasil!


Onde os influencers do Brasil fazem suas aulas particulares!


A Idioma Independente , referência em inovação no ensino de idiomas, está buscando pessoas proativas, com perfil proativo e fluência em um segundo idioma, que querem ter sucesso no âmbito profissional, para se credenciar como professores e fazer parte da nossa comunidade engajada.


Aqui, você não será apenas mais um perfil online: você será parte de uma rede colaborativa com mais de 400 professores e 4.000 alunos que vivenciam nossa metodologia transformadora hoje, além de mais de 1000 professores e 10.000 alunos que já fizeram parte desta história.


Nos últimos 12 meses tivemos mais de 22 mil alunos interessados em fazer aulas conosco. Professores novos têm lotado suas agendas em até 30 dias, quando são comprometidos, se comunicam de forma eficaz e tem agenda no horário da noite disponível.


*Esta não é uma vaga CLT*


O que oferecemos?


  • Capacitação intensiva para melhoria no ensino de aulas de acordo com a nossa metodologia inovadora
  • Acesso exclusivo a uma plataforma com mais de 400 vídeos de treinamento, baseada em uma metodologia que já entregou resultados incríveis, com vídeos totalmente atualizados .
  • Mentorias semanais com especialistas experientes, que já treinaram mais de 1500 profissionais.
  • Plataforma exclusiva para acompanhamento das aulas.
  • Participação no nosso processo de captação de alunos, com possibilidade de ganhos adicionais relevantes, bastando você se interessar.
  • Descontos exclusivos em cursos de idiomas e viagens com a nossa comunidade.
  • Possibilidade de desenvolvimento e mentoria para ser um empreendedor de sucesso (se você quiser).
  • Um banco de aulas com mais de 800 aulas para facilitar o seu processo de construção de aulas.
  • Certificações dos treinamentos feitos dentro da comunidade que garantem que você obterá mais resultados juntos aos seus alunos e que agregam na sua carreira como professor independente.


Como saber se você é a pessoa certa para fazer parte da maior comunidade de professores independentes do Brasil?


Se você tem grandes ambições para impactar a educação no Brasil, acredita que o ensino de idiomas precisa de inovação, quer otimizar sua agenda de aulas e, ainda, gostaria de crescer como empreendedor, este é o lugar certo para você.


Necessário:


  • Maior de 18 anos , fluente em Português e outro idioma.
  • Disponibilidade de ao menos 20 horas semanais para treinamentos, aulas e ações práticas Esta é uma necessidade para obter os maiores retornos que a comunidade pode te proporcionar.
  • Possibilidade de participar em capacitações durante a semana, no turno da manhã ou tarde.
  • Independência para executar atividades, espírito de colaboração e vontade de contribuir para uma comunidade.


O diferencial?


Aqui você é mais que um professor.


Você será parte de uma comunidade de professores no ensino de idiomas , onde o trabalho colaborativo é a base para alcançar resultados de mercado altamente competitivos.


Esta não é uma vaga CLT , mas sim uma oportunidade de empreender e ser dono do seu crescimento com total suporte e estrutura de uma empresa inovadora.


Você cria laços e relações de confiança com pessoas que realmente se esforçam para te ajudar no seu desenvolvimento, devido ao modelo de negócio inovador que proporciona relações colaborativas e efetivas.


Se você tem vontade de fazer diferente e de vivenciar algo novo na sua história profissional, a ii com certeza é o seu lugar.


Faça parte da mudança no ensino de idiomas. Junte-se à Idioma Independente e transforme sua carreira e a vida de milhares de alunos!


O que eu faço?


  • Recebo capacitação para dar a melhor aula experimental da sua vida
  • Recebo capacitação em nossa metodologia, aprendendo como transformar a vida de muitos alunos, entregando resultado para eles/as
  • Recebo treinamentos e capacitações recorrentes com mentores experientes e especializados
  • Organizo e escolho a minha agenda e os horários que gostaria de ter alunos/as
  • Preparo aulas para os meus alunos/as
  • Dou as aulas para os meus alunos/as


Se você quiser ir além, também será possível, basta você se engajar na comunidade e aprender mais sobre todas as áreas do seu negócio.


QUANTO EU RECEBO POR ISSO?


  • Se você for somente professor, se dedicando 40h na semana a aulas, você poderá receber até R$4.000,00 por mês.
  • Se você quiser aprender sobre diferentes áreas e se engajar na comunidade, você pode construir uma renda mensal de até R$6.000,00 por mês em aproximadamente 1 ano.
  • Se você realmente quiser crescer e se desenvolver, se dedicando de forma integral junto da comunidade é possível chegar até R$12.000,00 por mês em 2 anos.


Tudo isso só dependerá de você, se quiser aprender mais sobre as partes comerciais e sobre como se tornar um mentor/a de professores.


Seja diferente, seja independente

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
About Eightpoint


Eightpoint is an internet technology company specializing in the agile development of products and content that address real-world interests, captivating users and driving significant growth for partners. With offices in the United States and Cayman Islands, Eightpoint collaborates with partners globally on the next generation of user-centric offerings. Our growing ecosystem includes innovative products like Weather Now, a sleek app that delivers real-time forecasts with clarity and ranks among the top three most-used weather apps in the U.S.; Check Heart Rate Now, a quick and easy wellness monitor; and Wave Browser, a powerful and secure way to search the web. Every product we launch is designed to engage users, enhance daily life, and deliver real-world value. Backed by data and driven by a relentless commitment to quality, Eightpoint moves fast, thinks big, and builds digital experiences that people love.


About the Role


We are seeking a Full-Stack Data Engineer to join our Mobile Applications department. This is a hybrid role that combines data engineering with data science overlap, giving you full ownership of the data lifecycle — from ingestion to transformation, analysis, and storytelling.

You will build and optimize scalable pipelines, ingest mobile app data from diverse sources, ensure infrastructure reliability, and deliver insights that directly influence how our apps grow. The ideal candidate thrives at the intersection of engineering and analytics, equally capable of writing production-grade pipelines and uncovering meaningful trends in user behavior.


Key Responsibilities


Data Infrastructure & Pipelines

  • Build and maintain scalable, end-to-end pipelines across cloud environments. Ingest and transform data from files, APIs, mobile telemetry (Firebase, Amplitude, Google Analytics), and external databases into centralized stores.
  • Continuously monitor, troubleshoot, and optimize infrastructure for performance, scalability, and cost-effectiveness.
  • Implement data quality monitoring, governance policies, and best practices for privacy, security, and compliance.
  • Participate in technical architecture discussions, contributing expertise on scalable, efficient data systems.


Analytics & Insights

  • Conduct exploratory and advanced analysis using SQL, Python, and statistical methods.
  • Collaborate with Analysts, Data Scientists, and Product Managers to translate business requirements into technical solutions.
  • Support experimentation and A/B testing by ensuring clean, reliable datasets and analyzing results.
  • Deliver actionable recommendations that influence mobile product strategy, user acquisition, and retention.


Collaboration & Best Practices

  • Engage in peer code reviews to uphold high standards of quality and maintainability.
  • Work cross-functionally with software engineering and business teams to ensure data solutions align with company priorities.
  • Document pipelines, workflows, and methodologies to foster reusability and knowledge sharing.


Who You Are


  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field.
  • 3+ years of experience as a Data Engineer or in a similar technical role focused on data infrastructure and pipelines.
  • Strong expertise in SQL and proficiency in Python (or a similar programming language such as Java or C#).
  • Experience with AWS (Redshift, RDS, S3) and Google Cloud (BigQuery, Firebase) for managing cloud-based databases and analytics tools.
  • Familiarity with data pipeline orchestration tools (dbt, Airflow, or similar).
  • Strong knowledge of data warehousing concepts, ELT/ETL best practices, and dimensional modeling. Experience with version control systems (e.g., GitHub).
  • Excellent communicator who can bridge technical depth with clear storytelling for non-technical stakeholders.
